vi.name: Hands of God
vi.description: Triệu hồi bàn tay thần để phán xử quân địch.
vi.detailDescription: Cứ mỗi <color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color> giây, tấn công địch xung quanh bằng DPS của bản thân với sát thương <color=#46CCFF>gấp secondValue</color>. Có <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> khả năng bỏ qua DEF và Tránh né của địch để tấn công.

id.name: Tangan Tuhan
id.description: Panggil Tangan Tuhan untuk menilai musuh.
id.detailDescription: <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> peluang menghiraukan pertahanan dan penghindaran dan menyerang musuh terdekat setiap <color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color> detik dengan kerusakan sama dengan <color=#46CCFF>secondValueTimes</color> ATK mereka setiap detik.

ko.name: 송오브피스
ko.description: 감미로운 음악을 연주하여 주변 아군을 회복시킨다.
ko.detailDescription: 주변 아군의 체력, 허기, 기분을 <color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color>초마다 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>만큼 회복 (중복안됨)

ja.name: ソング・オブ・ピース
ja.description: とろけるように甘い演奏で周辺の味方を回復させる。
ja.detailDescription: 周辺の味方の体力、空腹、気分を<color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color>秒ごとに<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>程度回復させる(重複なし)

en.name: Song of Peace
en.description: Helps nearby Allies recover by playing sweet music.
en.detailDescription: Recovers the HP, Satiety and Mood of nearby allies by <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> every <color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color> seconds (not duplicated).

zh-TW.name: 和平之歌
zh-TW.description: 演奏甜美的音樂，恢復周圍的友軍。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 周圍友軍的體力, 飢餓, 心情每秒<color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color>恢復<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>(不可重複)。

zh-CN.name: 和平之歌
zh-CN.description: 演奏甜美的音乐，恢复周围的友军。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 周围友军的体力, 饥饿, 心情每秒<color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color>恢复<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>(不可重复)。

ru.name: Песня Мира
ru.description: Помогает ближайшим союзникам восстановиться, играя прекрасную музыку.
ru.detailDescription: Восстанавливает ОЗ, сытость и настроение ближайших союзников на <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> каждые <color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color> сек. (не дублируется).

fr.name: Chanson de paix
fr.description: Aide les alliés à proximité à récupérer en jouant de la musique douce.
fr.detailDescription: Récupère le PV, la satiété et l'humeur des alliés proches de <color=#46CCFF> keepValue%</color> toutes les <color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color> secondes (non dupliqué)

es.name: Canción de Paz
es.description: Ayuda a los aliados cercanos a recuperarse tocando música suave.
es.detailDescription: Recupera el HP, la saciedad y el humor de los aliados cercanos a <color=#46CCFF> keepValue% </color> cada <color=#46CCFF>valueTime </color> segundos. (no duplicado)

pt.name: Canção de Paz
pt.description: Ajude aliados próximos a se recuperarem tocando música suave.
pt.detailDescription: Recupere o HP, saciedade e humor de aliados próximos a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> a cada <color=#46CCFF> valueTime </color> segundos. (não duplicado)

it.name: Canto di Pace
it.description: Aiuta i vicini Alleati a riprendersi suonando una dolce musica.
it.detailDescription: Recupera l'HP, la Sazietà e l'Umore degli alleati vicini di <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ogni <color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color> secondi (non duplicato).

de.name: Lied des Friedens
de.description: Spielt liebliche Musik und hilft so den Verbündeten in der Nähe bei der Erholung.
de.detailDescription: Regeneriert die HP, Sättigung und Stimmung von Verbündeten in der Nähe alle <color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color> Sekunden um <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. (nicht dupliziert)

th.name: ซองออฟพีซ
th.description: บรรเลงดนตรีอันไพเราะฟื้นฟูพันธมิตรรอบบริเวณ
th.detailDescription: ฟื้นฟู HP, ความหิว, อารมณ์ของพันธมิตรรอบบริเวณเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ในทุกๆ <color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color> วินาที (ทับซ้อนไม่ได้)

vi.name: Song of Peace
vi.description: Phát bản nhạc ngọt ngào giúp hồi phục quân đồng minh xung quanh.
vi.detailDescription: Phục hồi <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> HP, No đủ, Tâm trạng của quân đồng minh xung quanh mỗi <color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color> giây (Không trùng lặp)

id.name: Lagu Perdamaian
id.description: Bantu sekutu terdekat untuk sembuh dengan memainkan musik manis.
id.detailDescription: Memulihkan HP, Rasa Kenyang, dan Mood dari sekutu terdekat sebanyak <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> setiap <color=#46CCFF>valueTime</color> detik. (tidak digandakan)

ko.name: 포이즌봄
ko.description: 독가스 수류탄을 투척하여 적들을 중독시키고 혼란스럽게 만든다.
ko.detailDescription: <color=#46CCFF>valueTime초</color>동안 자신의 초당 공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 데미지로 <color=#46CCFF>0.5초</color>마다 회피와 방어력을 무시하고 광역 공격, 피격된 적의 회피력이 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>만큼 감소 (중복안됨)

ja.name: ポイズン・ボム
ja.description: 毒ガス手榴弾を投げ、敵を中毒状態にし、混乱させる。
ja.detailDescription: <color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>間自身の1秒あたりの攻撃力の<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>のダメージで<color=#46CCFF>0.5秒</color>ごとに回避と防御力を無視して広域攻撃、攻撃を受けた敵の回避力が<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>程度減少する(重複不可)

en.name: Poison Bomb
en.description: Throw a poison gas grenade to poison and confuse enemies.
en.detailDescription: Attacks all enemies within the range with <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> of DPS every <color=#46CCFF>0.5secs</color> during <color=#46CCFF>valueTimeSecs</color> while ignoring the enemies' Evasion and DEF. The Evasion of the enemies is lowered by <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. (not duplicated).

zh-TW.name: 毒氣彈
zh-TW.description: 裝滿毒瓦斯的手榴彈投向敵人，使敵人中毒並產生混亂。
zh-TW.detailDescription: <color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>間以自身的每秒攻擊力的 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 攻擊力在每 <color=#46CCFF>0.5秒</color>無視閃避率與防禦力進行廣泛攻擊，被攻擊的敵人的閃避率減少 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> (無中毒)

zh-CN.name: 毒气弹
zh-CN.description: 装满毒瓦斯的手榴弹投向敌人，使敌人中毒并产生混乱。
zh-CN.detailDescription: <color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>间以自身的每秒攻击力的<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 攻击力在每<color=#46CCFF>0.5秒</color>无视闪避率与防御力进行广泛攻击，被攻击的敌人的闪避率减少<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> (无中毒)

ru.name: Ядовитая Бомба
ru.description: Брось гранату с ядовитым газом и запутай врагов.
ru.detailDescription: Атакует врагов в пределе диапазона с <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> ДПС каждые <color=#46CCFF>0.5 сек.</color> в течение <color=#46CCFF>valueTimeSecs</color>, игнорируя при этом УКЛ. и ЗАЩ. У врагов снижается Уклонение на <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. (не дублируется).

fr.name: Bombe de Poison
fr.description: Lancez une grenade à gaz empoisonné pour empoisonner et confondre les ennemis.
fr.detailDescription: Attaque les ennemis à portée et inflige <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de DPS toutes les <color=#46CCFF>0.5secs</color> pendant <color=#46CCFF>valueTimeSecs</color> tout en ignorant l’évasion et la DEF des ennemis. L’évasion des ennemis est diminuée de <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.(non dupliqué)

es.name: Bomba de veneno
es.description: Lanza una granada de gas venenoso para envenenar y confundir a los enemigos.
es.detailDescription: Ataca a los enemigos dentro del alcance con <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de DPS todos los <color=#46CCFF>0.5secs</color> durante <color=#46CCFF>valueTimeSecs</color> mientras ignora la Evasión y DEF de los enemigos. Se reduce la Evasión de los enemigos de <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. (no duplicado)

pt.name: Bomba venenosa
pt.description: Jogue uma granada de gás venenoso para envenenar e confundir os inimigos.
pt.detailDescription: Ataca inimigos dentro do alcance com <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de DPS todos os <color=#46CCFF>0.5secs</color> durante <color=#46CCFF>valueTimeSecs</color> enquanto ignora a Evasão e DEF dos inimigos. A Evasão dos inimigos é reduzida de <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.(não duplicado)

it.name: Bomba di veleno
it.description: Lancia una granata di gas velenoso per avvelenare e confondere i nemici.
it.detailDescription: Attacca tutti i nemici entro il raggio d'azione con <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> di DPS ogni <color=#46CCFF>0.5sec</color> durante <color=#46CCFF>valueTimeSecs</color> ignorando Evasion e DEF dei nemici. L'Evasione dei nemici viene abbassata di <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. (non duplicato).

de.name: Giftbombe
de.description: Wirft eine Giftgas-Granate auf Gegner, um sie zu vergiften und zu verwirren.
de.detailDescription: Schadet einem Gegner in Reichweite für <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> der DPS alle <color=#46CCFF>0,5 Sekunden</color> über <color=#46CCFF>valueTime Sekunden</color> und reduziert Ausweichen der Gegner um <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. Ignoriert AUSWEICHEN und VERTEIDIGUNG des Gegners (nicht dupliziert).

th.name: พอยซั่นบอมบ์
th.description: ขว้างลูกระเบิดก๊าซพิษออกไป ทำให้ศัตรูติดพิษและสร้างความโกลาหล
th.detailDescription: ตลอดระยะเวลา <color=#46CCFF>valueTime วินาที</color> จะโจมตีเป็นวงกว้างทุกๆ <color=#46CCFF>0.5 วินาที</color> ด้วยความเสียหาย <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> ของพลังโจมตีต่อวินาทีของตัวเอง โดยไม่สนการหลบหลีกและพลังป้องกันของศัตรู และลดการหลบหลีกของศัตรูที่ถูกโจมตีลง <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> (ไม่ทับซ้อน)

vi.name: Bom độc
vi.description: Thả lựu đạn khí độc gây hoang mang và khiến quân địch trúng độc.
vi.detailDescription: Bỏ qua tránh né và phòng thủ mỗi <color=#46CCFF>0.5s</color> bằng sát thương <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> DPS của bản thân trong <color=#46CCFF>valueTimes</color> đồng thời tấn công trên diện rộng, khiến lực tránh né của địch bị tấn công giảm <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> (Không trùng lặp)

id.name: Bom Racun
id.description: Lempar granat gas racun ke racun dan buat musuh bingung.
id.detailDescription: Serang seluruh musuh dalam jangkauan dengan <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> DPS setiap <color=#46CCFF>0.5 detik</color> selama<color=#46CCFF>valueTime Detik</color> ketika menghiraukan penghindaran dan DEF musuh. Penghindaran musuh direndahkan sebanyak <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. (tidak digandakan).

ko.name: 서몬퍼밀리어
ko.description: 퍼밀리어를 소환하여 주인이 사용한 스킬을 흉내낸다.
ko.detailDescription: 썬더볼트, 블리자드, 스톤커즈, 메테오 사용시 퍼밀리어가 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 확률로 스킬을 재시전, 재시전된 스킬은 기존 스킬 데미지의 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 만큼의 피해량이 적용된다.

ja.name: ファミリア召喚
ja.description: ファミリアを召喚し、主人が使用したスキルを真似する。
ja.detailDescription: サンダーボルト、ブリザード、メテオ、石化の呪い使用時にファミリアが<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>の確率でスキルを再実行する。再実行されたスキルは元のスキルダメージの<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>だけのダメージが適用される。

en.name: Summon Familiar
en.description: Summons a familiar to imitate the skills used by the owner.
en.detailDescription: When using Thunderbolt, Blizzard, Meteor, or Stone Curse, the familiar has a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> chance to recast the skill, and the recast skill will deal <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> damage equal to the existing skill's damage.

zh-TW.name: 召喚獸
zh-TW.description: 召喚召喚獸模仿主人使用的技能。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 使用天雷動, 暴雪, 流星, 石化時召喚獸有 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 的機率再次施展技能, 重新施展的技能套用現有技能傷害的 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 的傷害量

zh-CN.name: 召唤兽
zh-CN.description: 召唤召唤兽模仿主人使用的技能。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 使用天雷动, 暴雪, 流星, 石化时召唤兽有 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 的机率再次施展技能, 重新施展的技能套用现有技能伤害的 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 的伤害量

ru.name: Призыв Знакомого
ru.description: Призовите знакомого, чтобы копировать навыкам, используемым владельцем.
ru.detailDescription: При использовании Стрелы Молнии, Метеор, Метели или Каменного Проклятия есть <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> шанс переделать навык, и переделанный навык нанесет <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> урона от существующего навыка.

fr.name: Invoquer un familier
fr.description: Invoque un familier pour imiter les compétences utilisées par le propriétaire.
fr.detailDescription: Lors de l'utilisation de Éclair, Blizzard, Météore ou Malédiction de Pierre, le familier a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> de chance de relancer la compétence, et la compétence relancée infligera <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de dégâts égaux aux dégâts de la compétence existante.

es.name: Invocar Familiar
es.description: Invoca a un familiar para imitar las habilidades utilizadas por el propietario.
es.detailDescription: Al usar Rayo, Ventisca o Petrificación, Meteorito, el familiar tiene una probabilidad de <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> para relanzar la habilidad, y la habilidad relanzada infligirá <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> daño igual al daño de la habilidad existente.

pt.name: Invocar Familiar
pt.description: Evoca um familiar para imitar as habilidades usadas pelo proprietário.
pt.detailDescription: Ao usar Raio, Nevasca ou Maldição de Pedra, Meteoro, o familiar tem uma chance de <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> de relançar a habilidade, e a habilidade relançada infligirá <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> dano igual ao dano da habilidade existente.

it.name: Invocare Familiari
it.description: Invoca un familiare per imitare le abilità usate dal proprietario.
it.detailDescription: Quando uso Fulmine, Tempesta di Ghiaccio o Maledizione di Pietra, Meteora il famiglio ha un <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> di percentuale di utilizzare di nuovo l'abilità, infliggendo danni pari al <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> dei danni dell'abilità.

de.name: Familiar beschwören
de.description: Ruft einen Familiar herbei, der die Fähigkeiten des Besitzers imitiert.
de.detailDescription: Bei der Verwendung von Blitz, Blizzard oder Steinfluch, Meteor, hat der Vertraute eine Chance von <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, die Fähigkeit erneut zu wirken und die neu gewirkte Fähigkeit verursacht <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> Schaden in Höhe des Schadens der bestehenden Fähigkeit.

th.name: ซัมม่อนแฟมิเลียร์
th.description: อัญเชิญแฟมิเลียร์ออกมาเลียนแบบสกิลของผู้เป็นเจ้าของ
th.detailDescription: เมื่อใช้ธันเดอร์โบลต์, บลิซซาร์ด, มิดิเออร์, สโตนเคิร์ส มีโอกาส <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ที่แฟมิเลียร์จะร่ายสกิลอีกครั้ง สกิลที่ถูกร่ายอีกครั้งจะสร้างความเสียหายเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> ของความเสียหายสกิลปัจจุบัน

vi.name: Summon Familiar
vi.description: Triệu hồi Familiar bắt chước skill mà chủ nhân đã sử dụng.
vi.detailDescription: Khi sử dụng Lôi Tiễn, Bão Tuyết, Meteor, Đá Nguyền Rủa, xác suất Familiar tái thi triển kỹ năng là <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, và kỹ năng được tái thi triển gây sát thương tương đương <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> sát thương của kỹ năng ban đầu.

id.name: Panggil Akrab
id.description: Panggil akrab untuk meniru keterampilan yang digunakan pemilik.
id.detailDescription: Saat menggunakan Thunderbolt, Blizzard, Meteor, atau Stone Curse, Familiar memiliki peluang <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> untuk menyusun ulang skill, dan skill yang disusun ulang akan memberikan <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> kerusakan sama dengan kerusakan skill aslinya.

ko.name: 폴리모프
ko.description: 다크로드로 변신하여 주변 적들을 움츠러들게 한다.
ko.detailDescription: 기본 공격이 근거리 공격으로 변경되며, 아이스아머의 지속시간을 2배로 증가, 주변의 적들의 공격력을 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>만큼 감소

ja.name: ポリモーフ
ja.description: ダークロードに変身し、周辺の敵をすくませる。
ja.detailDescription: 基本攻撃が近距離攻撃に変更され、アイスアーマーの持続時間が2倍に増加、周辺の敵たちの攻撃力を<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>くらい減少させる。

en.name: Polymorph
en.description: Transforms into the Dark Lord and destroys enemies.
en.detailDescription: The basic attack is changed to a close range attack, the Ice Armor duration is doubled and the ATK of nearby enemies is reduced by <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.

zh-TW.name: 變身
zh-TW.description: 變身為黑暗領主，讓周圍的敵人退縮。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 基本攻擊變為近身攻擊, 冰霜的持續時間增加2倍, 周邊敵人的攻擊力減少 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>

zh-CN.name: 变身
zh-CN.description: 变身为黑暗领主，让周围的敌人退缩。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 基本攻击变为近身攻击, 冰霜的持续时间增加2倍, 周边敌人的攻击力减少 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>

ru.name: Превращение
ru.description: Превращается в Темного Лорда и уничтожает врагов.
ru.detailDescription: Базовая АТК меняется на АТК с близкого расстояния, продолжительность ледяной брони удваивается, а АТК ближайших врагов уменьшается на <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.

fr.name: Polymorphe
fr.description: Se transforme en Seigneur des Ténèbres et détruit les ennemis.
fr.detailDescription: L'attaque de base est remplacée par une attaque à courte portée, la durée de l'Armure de Glace est doublée et l'ATQ des ennemis proches est réduite de <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.

es.name: Polimórfico
es.description: Conviértete en el Señor Oscuro y destruye a los enemigos.
es.detailDescription: El ataque básico se reemplaza por un ataque cercano, la duración de la armadura de hielo se duplica y el ATQ de los enemigos cercanos se reduce en <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.

pt.name: Polimórfico
pt.description: Transforme-se em Lorde Sombrio e destrua os inimigos.
pt.detailDescription: O ataque básico é substituído por um ataque de perto, a duração da Armadura de Gelo é dobrada e o ATQ dos inimigos próximos é reduzido em <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.

it.name: Polimorfo
it.description: Si trasforma nel Signore Oscuro e distrugge i nemici.
it.detailDescription: L'attacco basico viene cambiato in un attacco a distanza ravvicinata, la durata dell'armatura di ghiaccio è raddoppiata e la ATTK dei nemici vicini viene ridotta di <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.

de.name: Polymorph
de.description: Verwandelt sich in den Dunklen Lord und vernichtet die Gegner.
de.detailDescription: Der Basisangriff wird zu einem Nahkampfangriff, die Dauer der Eisrüstung verdoppelt sich und der Angriff von Gegnern in der Nähe sinkt um <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.

th.name: โพลีมอร์ฟ
th.description: แปลงร่างเป็นดาร์กลอร์ด ทำให้ศัตรูรอบบริเวณล่าถอย
th.detailDescription: เปลี่ยนการโจมตีพื้นฐานเป็นการโจมตีระยะใกล้ เพิ่มเวลาต่อเนื่องของไอซ์อาเมอร์ขึ้นเป็น 2 เท่า และลดพลังโจมตีของศัตรูรอบบริเวณเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>

vi.name: Polymorph
vi.description: Biến hình thành Dark Lord khiến địch xung quanh run rẩy.
vi.detailDescription: Tấn công cơ bản đổi thành tấn công cự ly gần, tăng gấp đôi thời gian phát huy của Giáp băng, giảm <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ATK của địch xung quanh.

id.name: Polimorf
id.description: Berubah menjadi Dark Lord dan hancurkan musuh.
id.detailDescription: Serangan dasar diubah ke serangan jarak dekat, durasi Baju Baja Es digandakan dan kekuatan serangan dari musuh terdekat dikurangi sebanyak <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.

ko.name: 펄버라이즈
ko.description: 이따금 검에서 충격파를 발산하여 대상과 주변의 적에게 피해를 입힌다.
ko.detailDescription: 일반 공격시 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 확률로 초당 공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 데미지로 방어력을 무시하고 광역공격

ja.name: パルヴァライザァ
ja.description: 時々、剣から衝撃波を発散して対象と周りの敵にダメージを与える。
ja.detailDescription: 一般攻撃時、<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>の確率で秒あたり攻撃力の<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>のダメージで広域攻撃を行う。(防御無視)

en.name: Pulverizer
en.description: Occasionally, the sword emits a shockwave that will deal damage to the target and nearby enemies.
en.detailDescription: During a basic attack, there is <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> chance of ignoring DEF and attacking enemies in wide-range, dealing as much damage as <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> of DPS.

zh-TW.name: 粉碎
zh-TW.description: 偶爾從劍中發出衝擊波,對對象和周圍的敵人造成傷害。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 一般攻擊時以 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 的機率以每秒 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 攻擊力無視防禦進行廣域攻擊

zh-CN.name: 粉碎
zh-CN.description: 偶尔从剑中发出冲击波,对对象和周围的敌人造成伤害。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 一般攻击时以 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 的机率以每秒 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 攻击力无视防御进行广域攻击

ru.name: Распылитель
ru.description: Время от времени меч испускает ударную волну, которая наносит урон по противнику и ближайшим противникам.
ru.detailDescription: Во время базовой атаки имеется <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> шанс игнорировать ЗАЩ. и атаковать противников с большой дистанции, нанося <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> урона от ДПС.

fr.name: Pulvériseur
fr.description: L'épée émet parfois des ondes de choc qui infligent des dégâts à la cible et aux ennemis proches.
fr.detailDescription: Pendant une attaque de base, il y a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> de chance d'ignorer la DEF et d'attaquer les ennemis, infligeant autant de dégâts que  <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de DPS.

es.name: Pulverizador
es.description: La espada a veces emite ondas de choque que dañan al objetivo y a los enemigos cercanos.
es.detailDescription: Durante un ataque básico, hay <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> de probabilidad de ignorar la DEF y atacar a los enemigos a corta distancia, infligiendo tanto daño como <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de DPS.

pt.name: Pulverizador
pt.description: A espada às vezes emite ondas de choque que danificam o alvo e os inimigos próximos.
pt.detailDescription: Durante um ataque básico, há uma chance de <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> de ignorar DEF e atacar inimigos de perto, causando tanto dano quanto <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de DPS.

it.name: Frantumatore
it.description: Ogni tanto, la spada provoca un'onda d'urto che infigge danno al bersaglio e ai nemici vicini.
it.detailDescription: Durante un attacco base, c'è il <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> di possibilità di ignorare DEF e attaccare i nemici entro un ampio raggio, infliggendo pari al <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> del DPS.

de.name: Pulverisator
de.description: Gelegentlich sendet das Schwert eine Schockwelle aus, die dem Ziel und nahen Gegnern Schaden zufügt.
de.detailDescription: <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> Chance, bei einem Normalangriff die Verteidigung des Gegners zu ignorieren und Gegner in großer Reichweite anzugreifen, wobei ihnen für <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> der DPS geschadet wird.

th.name: พัลเวอไรเซอร์
th.description: ดาบปล่อยคลื่นกระแทกเป็นระยะๆ สร้างความเสียให้เป้าหมายและศัตรูใกล้เคียง
th.detailDescription: เมื่อโจมตีปกติ มีโอกาส <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ที่จะโจมตีเป็นบริเวณกว้างสร้างความเสียหาย <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> ของ ATK / sec โดยเพิกเฉยต่อ DEF

vi.name: Pulverizer
vi.description: Đôi khi bắn ra sóng xung kích từ kiếm để gây sát thương cho đối phương và địch xung quanh.
vi.detailDescription: Khi tấn công cơ bản, xác suất bỏ qua DEF với sát thương tương đương <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> ATK mỗi giây và tấn công trên diện rộng là <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.

id.name: Penghancurlebur
id.description: Terkadang, pedang memancarkan gelombang yang akan memberikan kerusakan pada target dan musuh sekitar.
id.detailDescription: Saat serangan dasar, terdapat <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> peluang untuk mengabaikan DEF dan menyerang musuh dalam jangkauan luas, memberi kerusakan sebanyak <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> dari DPS.

ko.name: 다크웨폰
ko.description: 무기에 암속성을 부여하고 홀리라이트를 변형한다.
ko.detailDescription: 자신의 공격력이 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 증폭, 홀리라이트 사용 시 도발효과 대신 피해를 입은 적이 받는 모든 피해량이 <color=#46CCFF>valueTime초</color> 동안 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 증가

ja.name: ダークウェポン
ja.description: 武器に闇属性を付与し、ホーリーライトに変形させる。
ja.detailDescription: 自身の攻撃力が<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>増幅し、ホーリーライト使用時、挑発効果の代わりに、敵が受ける総ダメージ量が<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>間<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>増加する。

en.name: Dark Weapon
en.description: Gives the dark attribute to weapons and changes Holy Light.
en.detailDescription: Amplify own ATK by <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> and, when Holy Light is used, instead of a provoking effect, all damage taken by the target is increased by <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> for <color=#46CCFF>valueTime secs</color>.

zh-TW.name: 暗黑武器
zh-TW.description: 賦予武器暗屬性並使聖力之光改變。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 自身攻擊力增加<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, 使用聖力之光時將不產生挑釁效果, 但會使敵人受到的所有傷害量於<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>間增加<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>

zh-CN.name: 暗黑武器
zh-CN.description: 赋予武器暗属性并使圣力之光改变。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 自身攻击力增幅<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, 使用圣力之光时将不产生挑衅效果, 但会使敌人受到的所有伤害量于<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>间增加<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>

ru.name: Темное Оружие
ru.description: Выдает оружию атрибут Тьма и меняет Святой Свет.
ru.detailDescription: Усиливает собственное ATK на <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, а при использовании Святого Света вместо провоцирующего эффекта весь получаемый целью урон увеличивается на <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> в течении <color=#46CCFF>valueTime сек.</color>.

fr.name: Arme sombre
fr.description: Donne l'attribut sombre aux armes et modifie la Lumière Sacrée.
fr.detailDescription: Amplifie son propre ATQ de <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> et, lorsque la lumière sacrée est utilisée, tous les dégâts pris par l'objectif est augmenté de <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> pendant <color=#46CCFF>valueTime s</color> au lieu d'avoir un effet provocateur.

es.name: Arma oscura
es.description: Otorga el atributo oscuro a las armas y modifica la Luz Sagrada.
es.detailDescription: Amplifica su propio ATQ en <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> y cuando se usa Luz sagrada, todo el daño recibido por el objetivo aumenta en <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> durante <color=#46CCFF >valueTime s</color> en lugar de tener un efecto provocador.

pt.name: Arma sombria
pt.description: Dá atributo escuro às armas e modifica a Luz Sagrada.
pt.detailDescription: Amplifica o próprio ATQ de <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> e, quando a Luz Sagrada é usada, todo o dano recebido pelo o alvo é aumentado de <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> durante <color=#46CCFF>valueTime s</color> em vez de ter um efeito provocativo.

it.name: Arma oscura
it.description: Cambia l'attributo dell'arma in oscurità e modifica Luce Sacra.
it.detailDescription: Aumenta il proprio Angriff di <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> e, quando viene utilizzata Luce Sacra, invece di provocare il nemico, tutti i danni subiti dal bersaglio vengono aumentati di <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> per <color=#46CCFF>valueTime secondi</color>.

de.name: Dunkelwaffe
de.description: Verleiht der Waffe Dunkelheit und ändert Heiliges Licht.
de.detailDescription: Verstärkt den eigenen Angriff um <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> und anstatt Provozieren wird beim Einsatz von Heiliges Licht <color=#46CCFF>valueTime Sek.</color> lang der erlittene Gesamtschaden des Ziels um <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> erhöht.

th.name: ดาร์กเวพอน
th.description: มอบคุณสมบัติด้านมืดให้กับอาวุธและแปลงโฮลี่ไลท์
th.detailDescription: พลังโจมตีของตนเองขยายเพิ่มขึ้น <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> และเมื่อใช้งานโฮลี่ไลท์ จะทำให้ความเสียหายที่เป้าหมายได้รับเพิ่มขึ้น <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> เป็นเวลา <color=#46CCFF>valueTime วินาที</color> แทนที่การเกิดเอฟเฟกต์

vi.name: Dark Weapon
vi.description: Thêm thuộc tính bóng tối vào vũ khí và biến đổi Ánh sáng Thần.
vi.detailDescription: ATK của bản thân khuếch tán <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>; khi sử dụng Ánh sáng Thần, tất cả lượng sát thương mà địch (người nhận sát thương thay vì hiệu ứng khiêu khích) phải nhận tăng <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> trong <color=#46CCFF>valueTime giây</color>.

id.name: Senjata Kegelapan
id.description: Memberi atribut kegelapan pada senjata dan mengganti Cahaya Suci.
id.detailDescription: Memperkuat ATK sendiri sebesar <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> dan, saat Cahaya Suci digunakan, alih-alih efek provokasi, semua kerusakan yang diterima target meningkat sebesar <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> selama <color=#46CCFF>valueTime detik</color>.

ko.name: 서몬피닉스
ko.description: 피닉스를 소환하여 전투를 지원한다.
ko.detailDescription: 공격시 <color=#46CCFF>35%</color> 확률로 초당 공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 데미지로 적을 공격, 피해를 입은 적이 받는 모든 피해량이 <color=#46CCFF>valueTime초</color>간 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 증가 (공격 후 <color=#46CCFF>keepTime초</color>간 발동 불가)

ja.name: フェニックス召喚
ja.description: フェニックスを召喚して戦闘をサポートする。
ja.detailDescription: 攻撃時、<color=#46CCFF>35%</color>の確率で秒あたり攻撃力の <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>のダメージで敵を攻撃する。敵に与える総ダメージ量が<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>間 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>増加する。(攻撃後、 <color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間発動不可能)

en.name: Summon Phoenix
en.description: Summons the Phoenix to participate in the battle.
en.detailDescription: When attacking, there is a <color=#46CCFF>35%</color> chance of attacking the enemy by dealing as much damage as <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of DPS, and all damage taken by the enemy increases by <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> for <color=#46CCFF>valueTime secs</color> (cannot be activated for <color=#46CCFF>keepTime secs</color> after attacking.)

zh-TW.name: 鳳凰召喚
zh-TW.description: 召喚鳳凰並支援戰鬥
zh-TW.detailDescription: 攻擊時以 <color=#46CCFF>35%</color> 的機率以每秒攻擊力的 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 傷害對敵人進行攻擊, 受到攻擊的敵人的所受全部傷害量將於<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>間增加 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>  (攻擊後於 <color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間將無法發動)

zh-CN.name: 凤凰召唤
zh-CN.description: 召唤凤凰并支援战斗
zh-CN.detailDescription: 攻击时以 <color=#46CCFF>35%</color> 的机率以每秒攻击力的 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 伤害对敌人进行攻击, 受到攻击的敌人的所受全部伤害量将于<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>间增加 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>  (攻击后于 <color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>间将无法发动)

ru.name: Призыв Феникса
ru.description: Призывает Феникса для участия в битве.
ru.detailDescription: При АТК имеется <color=#46CCFF>35%</color> шанс нанести противнику <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> урона от УВС., и весь урон, увеличивается на <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> в течении <color=#46CCFF>valueTime сек.</color> (не может быть активирован в течение <color=#46CCFF>keepTime сек.</color> после атаки. )

fr.name: Invoquer Phénix
fr.description: Invoque le phénix pour participer à la bataille.
fr.detailDescription: Lors d'une attaque, il y a <color=#46CCFF>35%</color> de chance d'attaquer un ennemi en infligeant autant de dégâts que <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> de DPS, et tous les dégâts pris par l'ennemi augmente de  <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> pendant <color=#46CCFF>valueTime s</color> (ne peut pas être activé pendant <color=#46CCFF>keepTime s</color> après avoir attaqué.)

es.name: Invocar fénix
es.description: Invoca al fénix para participar en la batalla.
es.detailDescription: Al atacar, hay un <color=#46CCFF>35%</color> de probabilidad de atacar a un enemigo que inflige tanto daño como <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> de DPS, y todo el daño recibido por el enemigo aumenta en <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> durante <color=#46CCFF>valueTime s</color> (no se puede activar durante <color=#46CCFF>keepTime s</color> después de atacar).

pt.name: Invocar Fênix
pt.description: Invoca o fênix para participar na batalha.
pt.detailDescription: Ao atacar, há uma chance de <color=#46CCFF>35%</color> de atacar um inimigo causando tanto dano quanto <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> de DPS, e todo o dano recebido pelo inimigo aumenta por <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> durante <color=#46CCFF>valueTime s</color> (não pode ser ativado durante <color=#46CCFF>keepTime s</color> após atacar.)

it.name: Evoca fenice
it.description: Evoca la Fenice per aiutarti in battaglia.
it.detailDescription: Quando attacca, c'è una probabilità del <color=#46CCFF>35%</color> di attaccare il nemico infliggendo danni pari al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS e tutti i danni subiti dal nemico aumentano di <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> per <color=#46CCFF>valueTime secondi</color> (non può essere attivato per <color=#46CCFF>keepTime secondi</color> dopo l'attacco.)

de.name: Phönix beschwören
de.description: Beschwört den Phönix, um am Kampf teilzunehmen.
de.detailDescription: <color=#46CCFF>35%</color> Chance, beim Angriff den Gegner anzugreifen, wobei ihm für <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> der DPS geschadet wird. Erhöht erlittenen Gesamtschaden des Gegners <color=#46CCFF>valueTime Sek.</color> lang um <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> (Kann nach dem Angriff <color=#46CCFF>keepTime Sek.</color> lang nicht aktiviert werden)

th.name: ซัมมอนฟินิกซ์
th.description: เรียกฟินิกซ์มาร่วมต่อสู้
th.detailDescription: เมื่อโจมตีจะมีโอกาส <color=#46CCFF>35%</color> ที่จะโจมตีศัตรูสร้างความเสียหายเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ ATK / sec และความเสียหายทั้งหมดที่ศัตรูได้รับจะเพิ่มขึ้น <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> เป็นเวลา <color=#46CCFF>valueTime วินาที</color>  (หลังจากโจมตีจะไม่สามารถใช้งานได้ <color=#46CCFF>keepTime วินาที</color>)

vi.name: Summon Phoenix
vi.description: Triệu hồi phượng hoàng để chi viện cho trận đấu.
vi.detailDescription: Khi tấn công, xác suất tấn công địch với sát thương tương đương <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ATK mỗi giây là <color=#46CCFF>35%</color>, tất cả lượng sát thương mà địch nhận sát thương phải nhận tăng <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> trong <color=#46CCFF>valueTime giây</color>. (Sau khi tấn công, không thể hoạt động trong <color=#46CCFF>keepTime giây</color>.)

id.name: Panggil Phoenix
id.description: Memanggil Phoenix untuk ikut serta dalam pertarungan.
id.detailDescription: Saat menyerang, terdapat <color=#46CCFF>35%</color> peluang untuk menyerang musuh dengan memberikan kerusakan sebesar <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> dari DPS, dan semua kerusakan yang diterima musuh meningkat sebesar <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> selama <color=#46CCFF>valueTime detik</color> (tidak bisa diaktifkan selama <color=#46CCFF>keepTime detik</color> setelah menyerang.)

ko.name: 메테오
ko.description: 하늘에서 거대한 운석을 소환하여 공격한다.
ko.detailDescription: 자신의 초당 공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 데미지로 광역공격

ja.name: メテオ
ja.description: 空から巨大な雲石を召喚して攻撃する。
ja.detailDescription: 自分の秒あたり攻撃力の<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>のダメージで広域攻撃を行う。

en.name: Meteor
en.description: Summons a massive meteor from the sky to attack.
en.detailDescription: Wide area attack by dealing as much damage as <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of DPS.

ja.description: 酷い悪夢を召喚して対象と周りの敵をパニックに陥らせる。
ja.detailDescription: 自分の秒あたり攻撃力の<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>のダメージで広域攻撃を行い、的中した敵を<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>間パニック状態に陥らせる。

en.name: Nightmare
en.description: Summons a terrible nightmare, causing the target and nearby enemies to panic.
en.detailDescription: Wide area attack with as much damage as <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of DPS, and makes the target panic for <color=#46CCFF>valueTime secs</color>.

zh-TW.name: 惡夢
zh-TW.description: 召喚可怕的惡夢並給對象和周圍的敵人陷入恐慌。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 以自身每秒攻擊力 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 的傷害進行廣域攻擊, 命中的敵人將在  <color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>間陷入恐慌

zh-CN.name: 恶梦
zh-CN.description: 召唤可怕的恶梦并给对象和周围的敌人陷入恐慌。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 以自身每秒攻击力 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 的伤害进行广域攻击, 命中的敌人将在  <color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>间陷入恐慌

ru.name: Кошмар
ru.description: Вызывает ужасный кошмар, заставляя цель и ближайших противников паниковать.
ru.detailDescription: Атака в широком диапазе с <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> уроном от УВС, и заставляет цель паниковать на <color=#46CCFF>valueTime сек.</color>.

fr.name: Cauchemar
fr.description: Invoque un terrible cauchemar qui fait paniquer la cible et les ennemis proches.
fr.detailDescription: Attaque à grande échelle avec autant de dégâts que <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> de DPS, et fait paniquer la cible pendant <color=#46CCFF>valueTime s</color>.

es.name: Pesadilla
es.description: Invoca una pesadilla aterradora que provoca pánico en el objectivo y los enemigos cercanos.
es.detailDescription: Ataca con tanto daño como <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> de DPS y hace el objetivo entrar en pánico durante <color=#46CCFF>valueTime s</color>.

pt.name: Pesadelo
pt.description: Invoca um terrível pesadelo que faz com que o alvo e os inimigos próximos entrem em pânico.
pt.detailDescription: Ataca com tanto dano quanto <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> de DPS, e faz com que o alvo entre em pânico durante <color=#46CCFF>valueTime s</color>.

it.name: Incubo
it.description: Evoca un incubo terribile che spaventa il bersaglio e i nemici vicini.
it.detailDescription: Attacco ad ampia area con lo stesso danno del <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> di DPS e terrorizza il bersaglio per <color=#46CCFF>valueTime secondi</color>.

de.name: Alptraum
de.description: Beschwört einen schrecklichen Alptraum, der das Ziel und Gegner in der Nähe in Panik versetzt.
de.detailDescription: Flächenangriff, der <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS anrichtet, und versetzt das getroffene Ziel <color=#46CCFF>valueTime Sek.</color> lang in Panik.

th.name: ไนต์แมร์
th.description: เรียกฝันร้ายออกมา ทำให้เป้าหมายและศัตรูใกล้เคียงตื่นตระหนก
th.detailDescription: โจมตีเป็นวงกว้าง สร้างความเสียหาย <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ ATK / sec และทำให้ศัตรูตื่นตระหนกเป็นเวลา <color=#46CCFF>valueTime วินาที</color>

vi.name: Nightmare
vi.description: Triệu hồi ác mộng kinh hoàng để đẩy đối phương và địch xung quanh vào trạng thái hoảng loạn.
vi.detailDescription: Tấn công trên diện rộng với sát thương tương đương <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ATK mỗi giây của bản thân, đẩy địch bị trúng đòn vào trạng thái hoảng loạn trong <color=#46CCFF>valueTime giây</color>.

id.name: Mimpi Buruk
id.description: Mendatangkan mimpi yang sangat buruk, membuat target dan musuh sekitar panik.
id.detailDescription: Serangan area luas dengan kerusakan sebesar <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> dari DPS, dan membuat target panik selama <color=#46CCFF>valueTime detik</color>.

ko.name: 블레이드 피니쉬
ko.description: 하늘에서 검을 소환해 적을 공격한다.
ko.detailDescription:
자신의 초당 공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 데미지로 단일 공격
(PVP에서 스킬공격력 60% 감폭)

ja.name: ブレードフィニッシュ
ja.description: 空から剣を召喚し敵を攻撃する。
ja.detailDescription:
自身における毎秒の攻撃力の<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>のダメージを単体で付与する。
$(PVPではスキル攻撃力が60%減幅)$

en.name: Blade Finish
en.description: Summons a sword from the sky to attack enemies.
en.detailDescription:
Deals a single hit with damage equal to <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of the caster's DPS.
$(Skill ATK is deamplified by 60% in PvP)$

zh-TW.name: 刀刃拋光
zh-TW.description: 從天上召喚劍來攻擊敵人。
zh-TW.detailDescription:
以自身每秒攻擊力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的傷害進行單一攻擊
$(PVP中技能攻擊力下降60%)$

zh-CN.name: 刀刃抛光
zh-CN.description: 从天上召唤剑来攻击敌人。
zh-CN.detailDescription:
以自身每秒攻击力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的伤害进行单一攻击
$(PVP中技能攻击力下降60%)$

ru.name: Клинок Смерти
ru.description: Призывает меч с неба для атаки врагов.
ru.detailDescription:
Наносит один удар с уроном равный <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> от УвС заклинателя.
$(ATK навыка понижается на 60% в PvP)$

fr.name: Finition de la lame
fr.description: Invoque une épée depuis le ciel pour attaquer les ennemis.
fr.detailDescription:
Inflige un coup unique avec des dégâts égaux à <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> du DPS du lanceur de sorts.
$(L'ATQ de la compétence est déamplifié de 60% en JcJ)$

es.name: Acabado de la hoja
es.description: Invoda una espada desde el cielo para atacar a los enemigos.
es.detailDescription:
Inflige un solo golpe con un daño igual al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS del lanzador.
$(El ATQ de la Habilidad se desamplifica en un 60% en PvP)$

pt.name: Acabamento da lâmina
pt.description: Invoca uma espada do céu para atacar os inimigos.
pt.detailDescription:
Inflige um único golpe com dano igual a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> do DPS do lançador.
$(O ATQ da habilidade é desamplificado em 60% em PvP)$

it.name: Finitura della lama
it.description: Evoca una spada dal cielo per attaccare i nemici.
it.detailDescription:
Infligge un singolo colpo con danni pari al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS dell'incantatore.
$(Abilità ATK è de-amplificato del 60% in PvP)$

de.name: Klingenende
de.description: Beschwört ein Schwert vom Himmel, um Feinde anzugreifen.
de.detailDescription:
Verursacht einen einzelnen Treffer mit Schaden in Höhe von <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des SPS des Wirkers.
$(Fertigkeits-ANG wird im PvP um 60% geschwächt)$

th.name: เบลดฟินิช
th.description: อัญเชิญดาบจากฟากฟ้ามาปะทะเหล่าศัตรู
th.detailDescription:
โจมตีหนึ่งครั้งเพื่อสร้างความเสียหายเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ DPS ของผู้ร่าย
$(ATK สกิลจะลดฮวบลง 60% ใน PvP)$

vi.name: Hoàn tất Lưỡi kiếm
vi.description: Triệu hồi một thanh kiếm từ trên trời để tấn công kẻ thù.
vi.detailDescription:
Tấn công đòn đánh đơn với sát thương bằng <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ATK trên mỗi giây của bản thân
$(ATK kỹ năng bị giảm 60% trong PVP)$

id.name: Bilah Penghabisan
id.description: Memanggil pedang dari langit untuk menyerang musuh.
id.detailDescription:
Memberikan satu serangan dengan kerusakan setara <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS pengguna.
$(ATK Skill dilemahkan 60% di PvP)$

ko.name: 지휘의 함성
ko.description: 함성을 크게 내질러 아군의 사기를 진작시킨다.
ko.detailDescription: 주변 아군의 치명타 피해량을 <color=#46CCFF>keepTime초</color>동안 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 증가

ja.name: 指揮の咆哮
ja.description: 大声で叫び、味方の士気を高める。
ja.detailDescription: <color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間、周囲の味方のクリティカルダメージが<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>増加する。

en.name: Commanding Shout
en.description: Lets out a shout to raise the spirits of allies.
en.detailDescription: Critical hit damage of nearby allies is increased by <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> for <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>

zh-TW.name: 指揮吶喊
zh-TW.description: 大聲吶喊來振奮我軍士氣。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 周圍我軍的致命一擊傷害量於<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間增加<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>

zh-CN.name: 指挥呐喊
zh-CN.description: 大声呐喊来振奋我军士气。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 周围我军的致命一击伤害量于<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>间增加<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>

ru.name: Командирский Крик
ru.description: Издает клич, чтобы поднять дух союзников.
ru.detailDescription: Урон от КРИТ ближайших союзников увеличивается на <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> в течении <color=#46CCFF>keepTime сек.</color>

fr.name: Cri de commandement
fr.description: Lance un cri pour élever l'esprit des alliés.
fr.detailDescription: Les dégâts des coups critiques des alliés proches sont augmentés de <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> pendant <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>.

es.name: Grito del Comando
es.description: Lanza un grito para levantar el ánimo de los aliados.
es.detailDescription: El daño del golpe crítico de aliados cercanos aumenta en un <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> durante <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>

pt.name: Grito de comando
pt.description: Libera um grito para elevar o espírito dos aliados.
pt.detailDescription: O dano de acerto crítico de aliados próximos é aumentado em <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> por <color=#46CCFF>keepTime s</color>.

it.name: Grido di comando
it.description: Lancia un grido per sollevare gli spiriti degli alleati.
it.detailDescription: I danni da colpo critico agli alleati vicini sono aumentati del <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> per <color=#46CCFF>keepTime secondi</color>

de.name: Befehlsruf
de.description: Läst einen Schrei aus, um die Geister der Verbündeten zu heben.
de.detailDescription: Der krit. Trefferschaden von Verbündeten in der Nähe wird um <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> für <color=#46CCFF>keepTime Sek.</color> erhöht.

th.name: คำรามสั่งการ
th.description: ปลดปล่อยเสียงคำรามเพื่อปลุกขวัญพันธมิตร
th.detailDescription: ความเสียหายคริติคัลของพันธมิตรข้างเคียง เพิ่มขึ้น <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> เป็นเวลา <color=#46CCFF>keepTime วิ</color>

vi.name: Tiếng Hét Chỉ Huy
vi.description: Thả ra một tiếng hét để nâng cao tinh thần của đồng minh.
vi.detailDescription: Lượng sát thương CRIT của quân đồng minh xung quanh tăng <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> trong vòng <color=#46CCFF>keepTime giây</color>

id.name: Teriakan Perintah
id.description: Berteriak untuk membangkitkan semangat sekutu.
id.detailDescription: Kerusakan pukulan kritis sekutu di sekitar meningkat <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> selama <color=#46CCFF>keepTime detik</color>

ko.name: 징벌의 증표
ko.description: 일반 공격시 징벌의 증표를 생성하여 자신을 강화한다.
ko.detailDescription: 일반 공격시 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 확률로 징벌의 증표 획득. 징벌의 증표는 <color=#46CCFF>keepTime초</color>간 지속되며 1개당 자신의 공격력 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 증폭. 징벌의 증표는 최대 5개까지 보유

ja.name: 懲罰の証
ja.description: 一般攻撃時に懲罰の証を生成し、自身を強化する。
ja.detailDescription: 一般攻撃時、<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>の確率で懲罰の証を獲得する。懲罰の証は<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間持続、1個あたり自身の攻撃力が<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>増幅する。懲罰の証は最大5個保有できる。

en.name: Token of Punishment
en.description: Creates the Token of Punishment to enhance the caster during normal attacks.
en.detailDescription: During normal attacks, there is a <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> chance to obtain a Token of Punishment. The token lasts for <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> and each token amplifies the caster's ATK by <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. Up to 5 Tokens of Punishment can be held.

zh-TW.name: 懲罰的信物
zh-TW.description: 在一般攻擊時, 會生成懲罰的信物來強化自己。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 一般攻擊時, 有<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的機率獲得懲罰的信物。懲罰的信物會持續<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>, 每1個信物會讓自身攻擊力增強<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>。最多可持有5個懲罰的信物。

zh-CN.name: 惩罚的信物
zh-CN.description: 在一般攻击时, 会生成惩罚的信物来强化自己。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 一般攻击时, 有<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的机率获得惩罚的信物。惩罚的信物会持续<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>, 每1个信物会让自身攻击力增强<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>。最多可持有5个惩罚的信物。

ru.name: Знак Наказания
ru.description: Создает знак наказания для усиления заклинателя во время обычных атак.
ru.detailDescription: Во время обычных атак имеется <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> шанс получить Жетон Наказания. Жетон действует в течение <color=#46CCFF>keepTime сек.</color>, и каждый жетон усиливает ATK заклинателя на <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. можно удерживать до 5.

fr.name: Jeton de punition
fr.description: Crée le jeton de punition pour améliorer le lanceur lors des attaques normales.
fr.detailDescription: Pendant les attaques normales, il y a <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de chance d'obtenir un jeton de punition. Le jeton dure pendant <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> et chaque jeton amplifie l'ATQ du lanceur de sorts de <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. Vous pouvez détenir jusqu'à 5 jetons de punition.

es.name: Ficha del Castigo
es.description: Crea la Ficha de Castigo para mejorar al lanzador durante los ataques normales.
es.detailDescription: Durante los ataques normales, hay una probabilidad del <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de obtener una Ficha del Castigo. La ficha dura <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> y cada ficha amplifica el ATQ del lanzador en un <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. Se puede tener hasta 5 Fichas del Castigo.

pt.name: Ficha de punição
pt.description: Cria a ficha de punição para aprimorar os ataques normais do lançador.
pt.detailDescription: Durante ataques normais, há <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de chance de obter uma ficha de punição. O token dura <color=#46CCFF>keepTime s</color> e cada token aumenta o ATQ do lançador em <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. Você pode ter até 5 fichas de punição.

it.name: Gettone del Castigo
it.description: Crea il Token Punizione per potenziare l'incantatore durante i normali attacchi.
it.detailDescription: Durante gli attacchi normali, c'è una probabilità del <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> di ottenere un token dalla punizione. La piastrella dura <color=#46CCFF>keepTime secondi</color> e ogni piastrella amplifica l'ATK dell'incantatore del <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. Puoi avere fino a 5 Token Punizione.

de.name: Zeichen der Bestrafung
de.description: Erstellt das Zeichen der Bestrafung, um den Wirker bei normalen Angriffen zu verbessern.
de.detailDescription: Bei normalen Angriffen besteht eine Chance von <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>, ein Zeichen der Bestrafung zu erhalten. Das Zeichen hält für <color=#46CCFF>keepTime Sek.</color> und jedes Zeichen verstärkt den ANG des Wirkers um <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. Bis zu 5 Zeichen der Bestrafung können besitzt werden.

th.name: หลักฐานการลงทัณฑ์
th.description: สร้างหลักฐานแห่งการลงทัณฑ์ขึ้นมาเพื่อเสริมพลังให้ผู้ร่ายขณะโจมตีปกติ
th.detailDescription: ระหว่างการโจมตีปกติ จะมีโอกาส <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> ที่จะได้รับหลักฐานแห่งการลงทันฑ์ ซึ่งจะอยู่เป็นเวลา <color=#46CCFF>keepTime วิ</color> แต่ละอันจะขยาย ATK ของผู้ร่ายขึ้น <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> สามารถครอบครองหลักฐานแห่งการลงทันฑ์ได้มากสุด 5 อัน

vi.name: Dấu Hiệu Trừng Phạt
vi.description: Khi tấn công thường, tạo ra Dấu Hiệu Trừng phạt để cường hóa bản thân.
vi.detailDescription: Khi tấn công thường, có <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> cơ hội để nhận được một Dấu Hiệu Trừng Phạt. Dấu hiệu này kéo dài <color=#46CCFF>keepTime giây</color> và với mỗi một dấu hiệu ATK của bản thân tăng <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. Có thể sở hữu tối đa 5 Dấu Hiệu Trừng Phạt.

id.name: Simbol Hukuman
id.description: Menciptakan Simbol Hukuman untuk memperkuat diri selama serangan normal.
id.detailDescription: Pada serangan normal, terdapat <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> peluang memperoleh Simbol Hukuman. Simbol bertahan selama <color=#46CCFF>keepTime detik</color> dan setiap simbol memperkuat ATK pengguna sebesar <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>. Bisa mengumpulkan sampai 5 Simbol Hukuman.

ko.name: 빛의 은총
ko.description: 주변 아군에게 빛의 은총을 내려 보호한다.
ko.detailDescription: 주변 아군에게 아군 최대체력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 보호막 부여. 보호막은 최대 <color=#46CCFF>keepTime초</color>동안 지속

ja.name: 光の恵み
ja.description: 周囲の味方に光の恵みを付与し、保護する。
ja.detailDescription: 周囲の味方に最大体力の<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>のシールドを付与する。シールドは最大<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間持続する。

en.name: Light's Grace
en.description: Protects allies nearby with Light's Grace.
en.detailDescription: Allies nearby are protected with a shield that has <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of the ally's max HP. The shield lasts up to <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>

zh-TW.name: 光的恩典
zh-TW.description: 以光的恩典來保護附近的我軍。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 向周圍我軍賦予我軍最大體力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的保護罩。保護罩最久會持續<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>。

zh-CN.name: 光的恩典
zh-CN.description: 以光的恩典来保护附近的我军。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 向周围我军赋予我军最大体力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的保护罩。保护罩最久会持续<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>。

ru.name: Благодать Света
ru.description: Защищает союзников поблизости Благодатью Света.
ru.detailDescription: Союзники поблизости защищены щитом, который имеет <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> от макс. ОЗ союзника. Щит действует до <color=#46CCFF>keepTime сек</color>.

fr.name: La grâce de la lumière
fr.description: Protège les alliés à proximité avec la grâce de la lumière.
fr.detailDescription: Les alliés qui se trouvent à proximité sont protégés par un bouclier qui a une <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des PV max de l'allié. Le bouclier dure jusqu'à <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>.

es.name: Gracia de la Luz
es.description: Protege a los aliados cercanos con Gracia de la Luz.
es.detailDescription: Los aliados cercanos están protegidos por un escudo que tiene un <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del HP máx del aliado. El escudo dura hasta <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>

pt.name: A graça da luz
pt.description: Protege os aliados próximos com a graça da luz.
pt.detailDescription: Os aliados próximos são protegidos por um escudo que tem um <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> do PV máximo do aliado. O escudo dura até <color=#46CCFF>keepTime s</color>.

it.name: Grazia della Luce
it.description: Proteggi gli alleati stretti con la Grazia dalla Luce.
it.detailDescription: Gli alleati vicini sono protetti da uno scudo che ha il <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> degli HP massimi dell'alleato. Lo scudo dura fino a <color=#46CCFF>keepTime secondi</color>.

de.name: Anmut des Lichts
de.description: Schützt Verbündete in der Nähe mit Anmut des Lichts.
de.detailDescription: Verbündete in der Nähe werden durch einen Schild geschützt, der <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> der maximalen HP des Verbündeten hat. Der Schild hält bis zu <color=#46CCFF>keepTime Sek.</color> an.

th.name: ความกรุณาจากแสง
th.description: ปกป้องพันธมิตรที่อยู่ใกล้ด้วยความกรุณาจากแสง
th.detailDescription: พันธมิตรรอบข้างได้รับการปกป้องด้วยโล่ขนาดเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ HP สูงสุดของพันธมิตรนั้น โล่จะอยู่ได้นาน <color=#46CCFF>keepTime วิ</color>

vi.name: Ân Sủng của Ánh Sáng
vi.description: Bảo vệ đồng minh gần đó với Ân Sủng của Ánh Sáng.
vi.detailDescription: Thêm cho quân đồng minh xung quanh lớp màn bảo vệ tương đương <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> HP tối đa của quân đồng minh. Lớp màn bảo vệ này kéo dài trong <color=#46CCFF>keepTime giây</color>

id.name: Anugerah Cahaya
id.description: Melindungi sekutu di sekitar dengan Anugerah Cahaya.
id.detailDescription: Sekutu di sekitar dilindungi oleh perisai sekuat <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> HP maks sekutu. Perisai bertahan selama <color=#46CCFF>keepTime detik</color>

ko.name: 벤젠스
ko.description: 특별한 화살을 사용하는 복수의 화신으로 변신한다.
ko.detailDescription:
<color=#46CCFF>keepTime초</color>동안 일반공격시 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 확률로 복수의 화살을 시전. 복수의 화살은 자신의 초당 공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 데미지로 단일 공격
(PVP에서 스킬공격력 60% 감폭)

ja.name: 復讐
ja.description: 特殊な矢を操る、復讐の化身に変身する。
ja.detailDescription:
<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間一般攻撃時、<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>の確率で復讐の矢を放つ。復讐の矢は、自身における毎秒の攻撃力の<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>のダメージを単体で付与する。
$(PVPではスキル攻撃力が60%減幅)$

en.name: Vengeance
en.description: Transforms into the spirit of vengeance and uses special arrows.
en.detailDescription:
For <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>, during normal attacks, there is a <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> chance to cast Arrow of Vengeance. Arrow of Vengeance deals a single hit with damage equal to <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of the caster's DPS
$(Skill ATK is deamplified by 60% in PvP)$

zh-TW.name: 復仇
zh-TW.description: 變身為使用特別弓箭的復仇的化身。
zh-TW.detailDescription:
於<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間進行一般攻擊時, 有<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的機率施展復仇之箭。復仇之箭會以自身每秒攻擊力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的傷害進行單一攻擊。
$(PVP中技能攻擊力下降60%)$

zh-CN.name: 复仇
zh-CN.description: 变身为使用特别弓箭的复仇的化身。
zh-CN.detailDescription:
于<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>间进行一般攻击时, 有<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的机率施展复仇之箭。复仇之箭会以自身每秒攻击力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的伤害进行单一攻击。
$(PVP中技能攻击力下降60%)$

ru.name: Возмездие
ru.description: Превращается в духа мести и использует специальные стрелы.
ru.detailDescription:
В течение <color=#46CCFF>keepTime сек.</color>, во время обычных атак, имеется <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> шанс бросить Стрелу Возмездия. Стрела Возмездия наносит один удар с уроном, равным <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> от УвС заклинателя.
$(ATK навыка понижается на 60% в PvP)$

fr.name: Vengeance
fr.description: Se transforme en esprit de vengeance et utilise des flèches spéciales.
fr.detailDescription:
Pendant <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>, lors des attaques normales, il y a <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> chance de lancer 'Flèche de vengeance'. 'Flèche de vengeance' inflige un coup unique avec des dégâts égaux à <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> du DPS du lanceur de sorts
$(L'ATQ de la compétence est déamplifié de 60% en JcJ)$

es.name: Venganza
es.description: Se transforma en el espíritu de la venganza y utiliza flechas especiales.
es.detailDescription:
Durante <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>, al realizar ataques normales, hay una probabilidad del <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de lanzar la Flecha de la Venganza que inflige un solo golpe con un daño igual al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS del que lanza el hechizo
$(El ATQ de la Habilidad se desamplifica en un 60% en PvP)$

pt.name: Vingança
pt.description: Transforma-se em um espírito de vingança e usa flechas especiais.
pt.detailDescription:
Durante <color=#46CCFF>keepTime s</color>, durante ataques normais, há <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> chance de lançar 'Flecha da Vingança'.'Flecha da Vingança' causa um único golpe com dano igual a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> do DPS do lançador.
$(O ATQ da habilidade é deamplificado em 60% em PvP)$

it.name: Vendetta
it.description: Si trasforma nello spirito di vendetta e usa frecce speciali.
it.detailDescription:
Per <color=#46CCFF>keepTime secondi</color>, quando si eseguono attacchi normali, c'è una probabilità del <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> di lanciare Freccia della vendetta, che infligge un singolo colpo di danni pari al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS dell'incantatore.
$(Abilità ATK è de-amplificato del 60% in PvP)$

de.name: Rache
de.description: Verwandelt sich in den Geist der Rache und verwendet spezielle Pfeile.
de.detailDescription:
Für <color=#46CCFF>keepTime Sek.</color> besteht bei Normalangriffen eine <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> Chance, Pfeil der Rache zu wirken. Pfeil der Rache verursacht einen einzelnen Treffer mit Schaden in Höhe von <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des SPS des Wirkers.
$(Fertigkeits-ANG wird im PvP um 60% geschwächt)$

th.name: เวนเจินส์
th.description: แปลงตัวเองเป็นวิญญาณแห่งการล้างแค้นเพื่อใช้ธนูวิเศษ
th.detailDescription:
<color=#46CCFF>keepTime วิ</color> ระหว่างการโจมตีปกติ จะมีโอกาส <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> ที่จะปล่อยลูกธนูแห่งการล้างแค้น ซึ่งจะโจมตีหนึ่งครั้ง สร้างความเสียหายเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ DPS ของผู้ร่าย
$(ATK สกิลจะลดฮวบลง 60% ใน PvP)$

vi.name: Báo Thù
vi.description: Biến thành linh hồn của sự báo thù và sử dụng mũi tên đặc biệt.
vi.detailDescription:
Trong vòng <color=#46CCFF>keepTime giây</color> khi tấn công thường, có <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> cơ hội để thi triển Mũi Tên Báo Thù. Mũi Tên Báo Thù gây một cú đánh đơn với sát thương bằng <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS của bản thân.
$(ATK kỹ năng bị giảm mạnh 60% trong PVP)$

id.name: Pembalasan
id.description: Berubah menjadi roh pembalasan dan menggunakan panah khusus.
id.detailDescription:
Selama <color=#46CCFF>keepTime detik</color>, pada serangan normal, terdapat <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> peluang untuk melepaskan Panah Pembalasan. Panah Pembalasan memberikan satu serangan dengan kerusakan setara <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS pengguna
$(ATK Skill dilemahkan 60% di PvP)$

ko.name: 폴링 스타
ko.description: 하늘에서 별의 세례를 내려 적들을 공격한다.
ko.detailDescription:
<color=#46CCFF>valueTime초</color>동안 자신의 초당공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 데미지로 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue초</color>마다 광역공격 
(PVP에서 스킬공격력 60% 감폭)

ja.name: 流れ星
ja.description: 空から星を降らせ、敵を攻撃する。
ja.detailDescription:
<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>間、<color=#46CCFF>secondValue秒</color>おきに、自身における毎秒の攻撃力の<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>のダメージを与える広域攻撃を繰り出す。
$(PVPではスキル攻撃力が60%減幅)$

en.name: Falling Star
en.description: Pours down stars from the sky to attack enemies.
en.detailDescription:
Deals an AoE attack with damage equal to <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of the caster's DPS every <color=#46CCFF>secondValue sec</color> for <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>
$(Skill ATK is deamplified by 60% in PvP)$

zh-TW.name: 落星
zh-TW.description: 使天上降下星星的洗禮來攻擊敵人。
zh-TW.detailDescription:
<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>間, 以自身每秒攻擊力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的傷害進行每<color=#46CCFF>secondValue秒</color>的廣域攻擊。 
$(PVP中技能攻擊力下降60%)$

zh-CN.name: 落星
zh-CN.description: 使天上降下星星的洗礼来攻击敌人。
zh-CN.detailDescription:
<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>间, 以自身每秒攻击力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的伤害进行每<color=#46CCFF>secondValue秒</color>的广域攻击。
$(PVP中技能攻击力下降60%)$

ru.name: Падающая Звезда
ru.description: Сбрасывает с неба звезды для атаки противников.
ru.detailDescription:
Наносит AoE атаку с уроном, равным <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> от УвС заклинателя каждые <color=#46CCFF>secondValue сек.</color> в течение <color=#46CCFF>valueTime сек</color>.
$(ATK навыка понижается на 60% в PvP)$

fr.name: Étoile tombante
fr.description: Déverse des étoiles du ciel pour attaquer les ennemis.
fr.detailDescription:
Déclenche une attaque AoE avec des dégâts égaux à <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des DPS du lanceur de sorts tous les <color=#46CCFF>secondValue sec</color> pendant <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>
$(L'ATQ de la compétence est déamplifié de 60% en JcJ)$

es.name: Estrella Fugaz
es.description: Derrama estrellas del cielo para atacar a los enemigos.
es.detailDescription:
Inflige un ataque AoE con un daño igual al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS del lanzador del hechizo cada <color=#46CCFF>secondValue sec</color> durante <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>
$(El ATQ de la Habilidad se desamplifica en un 60% en PvP)$

pt.name: Estrela cadente
pt.description: Lança estrelas do céu para atacar os inimigos.
pt.detailDescription:
Desencadeia um ataque AoE com dano igual a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> do DPS do lançador a cada <color=#46CCFF>secondValue s</color> por <color=#46CCFF>valueTime s</color>.
$(O ATQ da habilidade é desamplificado em 60% em PvP)$

it.name: Stella cadente
it.description: Si riversa stelle dal cielo per attaccare i nemici.
it.detailDescription:
Sferra un attacco AoE con danni pari al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> dei DPS dell'incantatore ogni <color=#46CCFF>secondValue secondi</color> per <color=#46CCFF>valueTime secondi</color>.
$(Abilità ATK è de-amplificato del 60% in PvP)$

de.name: Fallender Stern
de.description: Lässt Sterne vom Himmel herabregnen, um Feinde anzugreifen.
de.detailDescription:
Führt einen Flächenangriff mit Schaden in Höhe von <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des SPS des Wirkers alle <color=#46CCFF>secondValue Sek.</color> für <color=#46CCFF>valueTime Sek.</color> aus.
(Fertigkeits-ANG wird im PvP um 60% geschwächt)

th.name: ฟอลลิงสตาร์
th.description: โปรยดวงดาวลงมาจากฟ้าเพื่อโจมตีศัตรู
th.detailDescription:
โจมตีวงกว้างสร้างความเสียหายเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ DPS ของผู้ร่าย ทุกๆ <color=#46CCFF>secondValue วิ</color> เป็นเวลา <color=#46CCFF>valueTime วิ</color>
$(ATK สกิลจะลดฮวบลง 60% ใน PvP)$

vi.name: Ngôi Sao Rơi
vi.description: Đổ sao từ trên trời xuống để tấn công kẻ thù.
vi.detailDescription:
Trong vòng <color=#46CCFF>valueTime giây</color>, tấn công diện rộng mỗi <color=#46CCFF>secondValue giây</color> với sát thương bằng <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS của bản thân.
$(ATK kỹ năng bị giảm mạnh 60% trong PVP)$

id.name: Bintang Jatuh
id.description: Memanggil bintang-bintang dari langit untuk menyerang musuh.
id.detailDescription:
Memberikan serangan area dengan kerusakan setara <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS pengguna setiap <color=#46CCFF>secondValue detik</color> selama <color=#46CCFF>valueTime detik</color>
$(ATK Skill dilemahkan 60% di PvP)$

ko.name: 마나차지
ko.description: 마나 오브를 획득하여 스킬을 강화한다.
ko.detailDescription:
헌터가 직접 썬더볼트를 시전시 마나 오브 <color=#46CCFF>valueCount개</color> 획득. 마나 오브는 <color=#46CCFF>keepTime초</color>동안 지속되며 최대 5개까지 보유. 오브 스킬 시전시 마나 오브를 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue개</color> 소모하여 스킬공격력 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 증폭. 
오브 스킬 : 블리자드, 스톤커즈, 메테오, 나이트메어 
퍼밀리어가 시전한 오브 스킬에도 마나차지 효과 적용. 
(PVP에서 증폭량 50% 감폭)

ja.name: マナチャージ
ja.description: マナオーブを獲得し、スキルを強化する。
ja.detailDescription:
ハンターが直接サンダーボルトを発動する場合、マナオーブを<color=#46CCFF>valueCount個</color>獲得する。マナオーブは、<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間持続し、最大5個保有できる。オーブスキル発動の際に<color=#46CCFF>secondValue個</color>のマナオーブを使い、スキル攻撃力を<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>増幅させる。
オーブスキル：ブリザード・ストーンカーズ・メテオ・ナイトメア
マナチャージ効果は、ファミリアが発動したオーブスキルにも適用される。
$(PVPでは増幅量が50%減幅)$

en.name: Mana Charge
en.description: Gathers mana orbs to enhance skills.
en.detailDescription:
When a hunter directly casts Thunderbolt, they obtain <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> mana orb(s). A mana orb lasts for <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>. Up to 5 mana orbs can be held. When casting an orb skill, <color=#46CCFF>secondValue</color> mana orb(s) are used to amplify the skill ATK by <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.
Orb skills: Blizzard, Stone Curse, Meteor, Nightmare
The Mana Charge effect also applies to orb skills cast by a Familiar.
$(Amplification is deamplified by 50% in PvP)$

zh-TW.name: 魔力充
zh-TW.description: 獲得魔力球來強化技能。
zh-TW.detailDescription:
獵人直接施展天雷動時, 會獲得<color=#46CCFF>valueCount個</color>魔力球。魔力球會持續<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>, 最多可持有5個。施展球體技能時, 會消耗<color=#46CCFF>secondValue個</color>魔力球, 技能攻擊力增強<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>。
球體技能：暴雪, 石化, 流星, 惡夢
召喚獸施展的球體技能也會套用魔力充效果。
$(PVP中技能攻擊力下降50%)$

zh-CN.name: 魔力充
zh-CN.description: 获得魔力球来强化技能。
zh-CN.detailDescription:
猎人直接施展天雷动时, 会获得<color=#46CCFF>valueCount个</color>魔力球。魔力球会持续<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>, 最多可持有5个。施展球体技能时, 会消耗<color=#46CCFF>secondValue个</color>魔力球, 技能攻击力增强<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>。
球体技能：暴雪, 石化, 流星, 恶梦
召唤兽施展的球体技能也会套用魔力充效果。
$(PVP中技能攻击力下降50%)$

ru.name: Заряд Маны
ru.description: Собирает сферы маны для улучшения навыка.
ru.detailDescription:
Когда охотник напрямую использует удар Грома, он получает <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> сферы(а) маны. Сфера маны действует в течение <color=#46CCFF>keepTime сек</color>. В руках можно держать до 5 сфер маны. Когда активируется навык, <color=#46CCFF>secondValue</color> сферы(а) маны используется для усиления ATK навыка на <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.
Навыки Сфер: Метель, Каменное Проклятие, Метеор, Кошмар
Эффект Заряд Маны также распространяется на навыки сфер, применяемые помощниками.
$(Усиление понижается на 50% в PvP)$

fr.name: Charge de mana
fr.description: Rassemble des orbes de mana pour améliorer ses compétences.
fr.detailDescription:
Lorsqu'un chasseur lance directement 'Éclair', il obtient <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> orbe(s) de mana. Un orbe de mana dure <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>. Il est possible de conserver jusqu'à 5 orbes de mana. Lorsqu'il lance une compétence d'orbe, <color=#46CCFF>secondValue</color> orbe de mana est utilisé pour amplifier l'ATQ de la compétence de <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.
Compétences d'orbe : Blizzard, Malédiction de pierre, Météore, Cauchemar
L'effet de charge de mana s'applique également aux compétences orbes lancées par un familier.
$(L'amplification est déamplifié de 50% en JcJ)$

es.name: Ataque del Maná
es.description: Recoge bolas de maná para mejorar las habilidades.
es.detailDescription:
Cuando un cazador lanza directamente un Rayo, obtienen <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> bola(s) de maná. Una bola del maná dura <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>. Se puede tener hasta 5 bolas de maná. Al lanzar una habilidad de la bola, se usan <color=#46CCFF>secondValue</color> bolas del maná para amplificar el ATQ de habilidad en un <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.
Habilidades de la Bola: Tempestad, Maldición de Piedra, Meteóro, Pesadilla
El efecto de Ataque del Maná también se aplica a las habilidades de bola lanzadas por un Familiar.
$(La amplificación de desamplifica en un 50% en PvP)$

pt.name: Carga de mana
pt.description: Reúne orbes de mana para aprimorar suas habilidades.
pt.detailDescription:
Quando um caçador lança 'Raio' diretamente, ele recebe <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> orbe(s) de mana. Um orbe de mana dura <color=#46CCFF>keepTime s</color>. Você pode ter até 5 orbes de mana. Ao lançar uma habilidade de orbe, <color=#46CCFF>secondValue</color> orbes de mana são usadas para aumentar o ATQ da habilidade em <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.
Habilidades de orbe: Nevasca, Maldição de Pedra, Meteoro, Pesadelo.
O efeito de carga de mana também se aplica a habilidades de orbe lançadas por um animal de estimação.
$(A amplificação é deamplificada em 50% em PvP)$

it.name: Attacco di Mana
it.description: Raccogli le palle di mana per migliorare le abilità.
it.detailDescription:
Quando un cacciatore lancia direttamente un fulmine, ottiene <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> palle di mana. Una palla di mana dura <color=#46CCFF>keepTime secondi</color>. Puoi avere fino a 5 palle di mana. Quando si lancia un'abilità palla, vengono utilizzate <color=#46CCFF>secondValue</color> palle di mana per amplificare l'abilità ATK del <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.
Abilità con il pallone: Tempesta, Maledizione della pietra, Meteora, Incubo L'effetto Mana Attack si applica anche alle abilità con la palla lanciate da un Familiare.
$(L'amplificazione di deamplifica del 50% in PvP)$

de.name: Manaladung
de.description: Sammelt Manakugeln, um Fertigkeiten zu verbessern.
de.detailDescription:
Wenn ein Jäger Blitz direkt wirkt, erhält er <color=#46CCFF>valueCountx</color> Manakugel. Eine Manakugel hält <color=#46CCFF>keepTime Sek.</color>. Bis zu 5 Manakugeln können gehalten werden. Beim Wirken einer Kugelfertigkeit werden <color=#46CCFF>secondValuex</color> Manakugel verwendet, um den ANG der Fertigkeit um <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> zu verstärken.
Kugelfertigkeiten: Blizzard, Steinfluch, Meteor, Albtraum
Der Manaladungseffekt gilt auch für Kugelfertigkeiten, die von einem Familiar gewirkt werden.
$(Die Verstärkung wird im PvP um 50% geschwächt)$

th.name: มานาชาร์จ
th.description: ได้รับมานาออร์บมาเสริมพลังสกิล
th.detailDescription:
เมื่อฮันเตอร์ร่ายธันเดอร์โบลท์ออกมาโดยตรง จะได้รับมานาออร์บ <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> อัน มานาออร์บจะอยู่ได้นาน <color=#46CCFF>keepTime วิ</color> สามารถถือได้สูงสุด 5 อัน เมื่อร่ายสกิลลูกแก้ว <color=#46CCFF>secondValue</color> มานาออร์บจะถูกใช้เพื่อขาย ATK สกิลขึ้น <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>
สกิลออร์บ: บลิซซาร์ด, สโตนเคิร์ส, เมทิออร์, ไนต์แมร์
เอฟเฟกต์ชาร์จมานายังได้ใช้กับสกิลลูกแก้วที่ร่ายโดยแฟมิเลียร์ด้วย
$(การขยายพลังจะลดฮวบลง 50% ใน PvP)$

vi.name: Tích Tụ Mana
vi.description: Thu thập các quả cầu mana để tăng cường kỹ năng.
vi.detailDescription:
Khi một thợ săn trực tiếp thi triển Sấm Sét, nhận được <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> quả cầu mana. Quả cầu mana duy trì trong <color=#46CCFF>keepTime giây</color>, và có thể sở hữu tối đa 5 Quả cầu. Khi thi triển kỹ năng Quả cầu, sử dụng <color=#46CCFF>secondValue</color> quả cầu mana để tăng ATK kỹ năng lên <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.
Kỹ năng Quả cầu: Bão tuyết, Đá Nguyền rủa, Meteor, Nightmare
Hiệu ứng Tích Tụ Mana cũng áp dụng cho các kỹ năng quả cầu do Thú triệu hồi thi triển.
$(Lượng tăng mạnh bị giảm mạnh 50% trong PVP)$

id.name: Cadangan Mana
id.description: Mengumpulkan bola mana untuk meningkatkan skill.
id.detailDescription:
Saat pemburu menggunakan Thunderbolt, mereka memperoleh <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> bola mana. Bola mana bertahan selama <color=#46CCFF>keepTime detik</color>. Dapat mengumpulkan sampai 5 bola mana. Saat menggunakan skill bola, <color=#46CCFF>secondValue</color> bola mana digunakan untuk memperkuat ATK skill sebesar <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>.
Skill bola: Badai Salju, Kutukan Batu, Meteor, Mimpi Buruk
Efek Cadangan Mana juga diterapkan pada skill bola yang digunakan oleh Familiar.
$(Penguatan dilemahkan 50% di PvP)$

ko.name: 엘리멘탈 포스
ko.description: 일반 공격시 화염 또는 얼음의 힘을 사용해 적을 공격한다.
ko.detailDescription:
일반공격시 <color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color> 확률로 엘리멘탈 포스를 시전하여 초당 공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 데미지로 화염 단일 공격 또는 초당 공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 데미지로 냉기 광역 공격.
(PVP에서 스킬공격력 60% 감폭)

ja.name: エレメンタルフォース
ja.description: 一般攻撃時に、炎や氷の力で敵を攻撃する。
ja.detailDescription:
一般攻撃時、<color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color>の確率でエレメンタルフォースを発動し、毎秒の攻撃力の<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>のダメージを与える火炎単体攻撃、または毎秒の攻撃力の<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>のダメージを与える氷広域攻撃を繰り出す。
$(PVPではスキル攻撃力が60%減幅)$

en.name: Elemental Force
en.description: Uses the power of flame or ice to attack enemies during normal attacks.
en.detailDescription:
During normal attacks, there is a <color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color> chance to cast Elemental Force to either deal a single flame hit with damage equal to <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of the DPS, or deal an AoE ice attack with damage equal to <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> of the DPS.
$(Skill ATK is deamplified by 60% in PvP)$

zh-TW.name: 元素之力
zh-TW.description: 一般攻擊時, 使用火焰或冰的力量來攻擊敵人。
zh-TW.detailDescription:
一般攻擊時, 有<color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color>的機率施展元素之力, 以每秒攻擊力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的傷害進行火焰單一攻擊, 或是以每秒攻擊力<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的傷害進行寒氣廣域攻擊。
$(PVP中技能攻擊力下降60%)$

zh-CN.name: 元素之力
zh-CN.description: 一般攻击时, 使用火焰或冰的力量来攻击敌人。
zh-CN.detailDescription:
一般攻击时, 有<color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color>的机率施展元素之力, 以每秒攻击力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的伤害进行火焰单一攻击, 或是以每秒攻击力<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的伤害进行寒气广域攻击。
$(PVP中技能攻击力下降60%)$

ru.name: Сила Стихии
ru.description: Использует силу пламени или льда для атаки врагов во время обычных атак.
ru.detailDescription:
Во время обычных атак имеется <color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color> шанс применения Силы Стихий, чтобы нанести одиночный удар пламенем с уроном, равным <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> от УвС, или нанести ледяную атаку AoE с уроном, равным <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> от УвС. 
$(ATK навыка понижается на 60% в PvP)$

fr.name: Force élémentaire
fr.description: Utilise le pouvoir des flammes ou de la glace pour attaquer les ennemis pendant les attaques normales.
fr.detailDescription:
Pendant les attaques normales, il y a une <color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color> chance de lancer 'Force élémentaire' pour soit infliger un coup de flamme unique avec des dégâts égaux à <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> du DPS, soit infliger une attaque de glace AoE avec des dégâts égaux à <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> du DPS.
$(L'ATQ de la compétence est déamplifié de 60% en JcJ)$

es.name: Fuerza Elemental
es.description: Utiliza el poder de las llamas o el hielo para atacar a los enemigos durante los ataques normales.
es.detailDescription:
Durante ataques normales, hay una probabilidad del <color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color> de lanzar una Fuerza Elemental para asestar un solo golpe conllamas con un daño igual al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS, o asestar un ataque de hielo AoE con un daño igual al <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> del DPS.
$(El ATQ de la Habilidad se desamplifica en un 60% en PvP)$

pt.name: Força elementar
pt.description: Usa o poder da chama ou do gelo para atacar os inimigos durante os ataques normais.
pt.detailDescription:
Durante ataques normais, há <color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color> chance de lançar 'Força Elemental' para infligir um único ataque de chamas com dano igual a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> do DPS, ou infligir um ataque de gelo AoE com dano igual a <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> do DPS.
$(O ATQ da habilidade é desamplificado em 60% em PvP)$

it.name: Forza Elementale
it.description: Usa il potere delle fiamme o del ghiaccio per attaccare i nemici durante i normali attacchi.
it.detailDescription:
Durante gli attacchi normali, c'è una probabilità del <color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color> di lanciare una Forza Elementale per infliggere un singolo colpo di fiamma con danni pari al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS, o infliggere un attacco di ghiaccio AoE con danni pari al <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> del DPS.
$(Abilità ATK è de-amplificato del 60% in PvP)$

de.name: Elementarkraft
de.description: Verwendet die Kraft von Flammen oder Eis, um Feinde bei normalen Angriffen anzugreifen.
de.detailDescription:
<color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color> Chance, bei Normalangriffen Elementarkraft einzusetzen, um entweder einen einzelnen Flammentreffer mit Schaden in Höhe von <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des SPS zu verursachen oder einen Eis-Flächenangriff mit Schaden in Höhe von <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> des SPS zu verursachen.
$(Fertigkeits-ANG wird im PvP um 60% geschwächt)$

th.name: เอเลเมนทัลฟอร์ซ
th.description: ใช้พลังแห่งเปลวไฟและน้ำแข็งเพื่อโจมตีศัตรูขณะโจมตีปกติ
th.detailDescription:
ระหว่างการโจมตีปกติ จะมีโอกาส <color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color> ที่จะร่ายเอเลเมนทัลฟอร์ซ ที่จะโจมตีด้วยไฟหนึ่งครั้ง สร้างความเสียหาย <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ DPS หรือไม่ก็โจมตีเป็นวงกว้างด้วยน้ำแข็ง ซึ่งสร้างความเสียหาย <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> ของ DPS
$(ATK สกิลจะลดฮวบลง 60% ใน PvP)$

vi.name: Lực Lượng Nguyên Tố
vi.description: Sử dụng sức mạnh của lửa hoặc băng để tấn công kẻ thù trong các cuộc tấn công thường.
vi.detailDescription:
Khi tấn công thường, có <color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color> cơ hội để thi triển Lực Lượng Nguyên Tố để hoặc gây một cú đánh lửa đơn với sát thương bằng <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS, hoặc đòn tấn công diện rộng băng với sát thương bằng <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> của DPS.
$(ATK kỹ năng bị giảm mạnh 60% trong PVP)$

id.name: Kekuatan Elemen
id.description: Menggunakan kekuatan api atau es untuk menyerang musuh selama serangan normal.
id.detailDescription:
Pada serangan normal, terdapat <color=#46CCFF>valueCount%</color> peluang untuk menggunakan Kekuatan Elemen dan memberikan satu serangan api dengan kerusakan setara <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS, atau serangan es area dengan kerusakan setara <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> DPS.
$(ATK Skill dilemahkan 60% di PvP)$

ko.name: 에퀴테이션
ko.description: 기마술의 정점에 도달해 탈 것을 탈 때 강력한 위력을 발휘한다.
ko.detailDescription: 받는 피해 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 감소, 라운드 슬래쉬 사용시 2연타 (추가 공격은 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>의 데미지로 공격) 에퀴테이션은 탈 것에 탑승중일 때만 적용되며 드래곤나이트의 드래곤도 탈 것으로 간주한다.

ja.name: 馬術
ja.description: 騎馬術の頂点に到達し、乗り物に乗っている時に強力な威力を発揮する。
ja.detailDescription: 受けるダメージが<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>減少し、ラウンドスラッシュ使用時2連打(追加攻撃は<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>のダメージで攻撃) エキテーションは乗ることに搭乗中の時のみ適用され、ドラゴンナイ。

en.name: Equitation
en.description: Reaches the pinnacle of horsemanship, unleashing great power while mounted.
en.detailDescription: The damage taken is reduced by <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, and using Round Slash casts two attacks (additional attack deals <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> damage). Equitation is only applied while mounted, and the dragon of the Dragon Knight also counts as a mount.

zh-TW.name: 馬術
zh-TW.description: 乘馬術達到巔峰, 騎乘坐騎時發揮強大的威力。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 受到傷害減少<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, 使用迴旋斬擊時2連擊(以<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的傷害進行額外攻擊)。馬術僅在搭乘坐騎時套用, 龍騎士的龍也視為坐騎。

zh-CN.name: 马术
zh-CN.description: 乘马术达到巅峰, 骑乘坐骑时发挥强大的威力。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 受到伤害减少<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, 使用回旋斩击时2连击(以<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的伤害进行额外攻击)。马术仅在搭乘坐骑时套用, 龙骑士的龙也视为坐骑。

ru.name: Езда на лошади
ru.description: Достигает вершины верховой езды, высвобождая огромную силу, находясь в седле.
ru.detailDescription: Получаемый урон снижается на <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, а использование навыка Круговой удар наносит две атаки (дополнительная атака наносит <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> урона). Езда на лошади действует только во время верховой езды, и дракон Драконьего Рыцаря также считается ездовым животным.

fr.name: Équitation
fr.description: Atteint le sommet de l'art équestre, déchaînant une puissance colossale à cheval.
fr.detailDescription: Les dégâts subis sont réduits de <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, et l'utilisation de Slash circulaire lance deux attaques (l'attaque supplémentaire inflige <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de dégâts). L'effet Équitation n'est actif que lorsque vous êtes monté, et le dragon du Chevalier dragon compte également comme une monture.

es.name: Equitación
es.description: Alcanza la cima de la equitación, desatando un gran poder mientras está montado.
es.detailDescription: El daño recibido se reduce en <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, y usar Corte Redondo ejecuta dos ataques (el ataque adicional inflige <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de daño). La Equitación solo se aplica mientras estás montado, y el dragón del Caballero Dragón también cuenta como montura.

pt.name: Equitação
pt.description: Atinge o ápice da arte equestre, liberando um poder colossal a cavalo.
pt.detailDescription: O dano recebido é reduzido em <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, e usar o Golpe Circular desfere dois ataques (o ataque adicional causa <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de dano). O efeito de Montaria só está ativo enquanto o cavaleiro estiver montado, e o dragão do Cavaleiro Dragão também conta como montaria.

it.name: Equitazione
it.description: Raggiunge il culmine dell'equitazione, scatenando un grande potere mentre è a cavallo.
it.detailDescription: I danni subiti sono ridotti del <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> e l’uso di Colpo Rotondo genera due attacchi (l’attacco aggiuntivo infligge <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> danni). L’Equitazione si applica solo quando si è a cavallo e il drago del Cavaliere Drago conta anch’esso come cavalcatura.

de.name: Reiten
de.description: Erreicht den Höhepunkt der Reitkunst und entfesselt große Kraft im Sattel.
