de.detailDescription: Der erlittene Schaden wird um <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> verringert, und die Verwendung von Runder Schnitt löst zwei Angriffe aus (der zusätzliche Angriff verursacht <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> Schaden). Reiten wird nur angewendet, während man beritten ist, und der Drache des Drachenritters zählt ebenfalls als Reittier.

th.name: เอควิเทชัน
th.description: บรรลุทักษะควบคุมอาชาขั้นสูงสุด ปลดปล่อยพลังมหาศาลเมื่อขี่สัตว์พาหนะ
th.detailDescription: ความเสียหายที่ได้รับลดลง <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> และการใช้ราวนด์สแลชจะโจมตีสองครั้ง (สร้างความเสียหาย <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>) เอควิเทชันใช้ได้เฉพาะเมื่อขี่สัตว์พาหนะ และมังกรของดรากอนไนท์นับเป็นสัตว์พาหนะ

vi.name: Kỵ Thuật Chiến Mã
vi.description: Đạt đến đỉnh cao kỵ thuật, phát huy sức mạnh vượt trội khi cưỡi thú.
vi.detailDescription: Sát thương phải nhận giảm <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, khi sử dụng Chém Vòng Cung, sẽ đánh 2 lần (đòn đánh thêm gây <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> sát thương). Kỵ Thuật Chiến Mã chỉ kích hoạt khi đang cưỡi thú, và rồng của Kỵ Sĩ Rồng cũng được xem là thú cưỡi.

id.name: Equitasi
id.description: Mencapai puncak berkuda, melepaskan kekuatan besar saat menunggang.
id.detailDescription: Damage yang diterima berkurang sebesar <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>, dan menggunakan Serangan Lingkaran memicu dua serangan (serangan tambahan memberikan <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> damage). Equitasi hanya berlaku saat sedang menunggangi tunggangan, dan naga dari Kesatria Naga juga dihitung sebagai tunggangan.

ko.name: 쉐도우 스트라이크
ko.description: 그림자의 힘을 가득 담아 적의 몸에 찔러넣는다.
ko.detailDescription: 자신의 초당 공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 데미지로 적의 회피를 무시하고 공격, <color=#46CCFF>valueTime초</color>간 스턴. 쉐도우랜서는 PVP 컨텐츠 시작시 최초 1회 <color=#46CCFF>keepTime초</color>간 타겟으로 지정되지 않으며 가장 거리가 먼 적에게 순간이동.

ja.name: シャドーストライク
ja.description: 影の力を満載して、敵の体に突き刺す。
ja.detailDescription: 自身の毎秒の攻撃力の <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> のダメージで敵の回避を無視して攻撃、<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>間、気絶。シャドーランサーはPVPコンテンツ開始時、最低1回<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間、ターゲットに指定されず、最も遠い敵へ瞬間移動。

en.name: Shadow Strike
en.description: Imbues the spear with the power of shadows, driving it into the enemy's body.
en.detailDescription: Ignore the enemy's evasion and attack them with damage equal to <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of the hunter's DPS and stun them for <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. At the start of a PvP match, the Shadow Lancer will not be selected for the first targeting for <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>, and will teleport to the furthest enemy.

zh-TW.name: 暗影襲擊
zh-TW.description: 注入滿滿的暗影之力並刺入敵人的身體。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 無視敵人的閃避並以自身每秒攻擊力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的傷害進行攻擊, 並使其眩暈<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>。暗影騎兵在PvP開始最初1次的<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間不會被指定為目標, 並瞬間移動至最遠距離的敵人。

zh-CN.name: 暗影袭击
zh-CN.description: 注入满满的暗影之力并刺入敌人的身体。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 无视敌人的闪避并以自身每秒攻击力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的伤害进行攻击, 并使其眩晕<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>。暗影骑兵在PvP开始最初1次的<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>间不会被指定为目标, 并瞬间移动至最远距离的敌人。

ru.name: Теневой удар
ru.description: Наполняет копье силой теней, вонзая его в тело врага.
ru.detailDescription: Игнорируйте уклонение врага и атакуйте его с уроном, равным <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> от УвС охотника, и оглушите его на <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. В начале PvP матча Теневой Копейщик не будет выбран для первой цели на <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> и телепортируется к самому дальнему врагу.

fr.name: Frappe de l'ombre
fr.description: Imprègne la lance du pouvoir des ombres, la plantant dans le corps de l'ennemi.
fr.detailDescription: Ignorez l'esquive de l'ennemi et attaquez-le avec des dégâts égaux à <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des DPS du chasseur, puis étourdissez-le pendant <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. Au début d'un match JcJ, le Lancier de l'ombre ne sera pas sélectionné comme première cible pendant <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> et se téléportera vers l'ennemi le plus éloigné.

es.name: Golpe Sombra
es.description: Imbuye la lanza con el poder de las sombras, clavándola en el cuerpo del enemigo.
es.detailDescription: Ignora la evasión del enemigo y ataca con un daño igual al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS del cazador y aturdiéndolos durante <color=#46CCFF>valueTime seg</color>. Al inicio de una partida de PvP, el Lanzador de Sombras no será seleccionado para el primer objetivo durante <color=#46CCFF>keepTime seg</color>, y se teletransportará al enemigo más lejano.

pt.name: Golpe Sombrio
pt.description: Imbui a lança com o poder das sombras, cravando-a no corpo do inimigo.
pt.detailDescription: Ignore a esquiva do inimigo e ataque com dano igual ao DPS do caçador (<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>), depois atordoe-o por <color=#46CCFF>valueTime seg</color>. No início de uma partida PvP, o Lanceiro das Sombras não será selecionado como o primeiro alvo por <color=#46CCFF>keepTime seg</color> e se teletransportará para o inimigo mais distante.

it.name: Colpo d'Ombra
it.description: Imbue la lancia con il potere delle ombre, trafiggendo il corpo del nemico.
it.detailDescription: Ignora l'evasione del nemico e attaccalo con danni pari a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS del cacciatore e stunnalo per <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. All'inizio di una partita PvP, il Lanciere d'Ombra non sarà selezionato per il primo targeting per <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> e si teletrasporterà al nemico più lontano.

de.name: Schattenangriff
de.description: Durchdringt den Speer mit der Kraft der Schatten und rammt ihn in den Körper des Feindes.
de.detailDescription: Ignoriere die Ausweichbewegung des Gegners und greife ihn mit einem Schaden an, der <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des DPS des Jägers entspricht, und betäube ihn für <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. Zu Beginn eines PvP-Matches wird der Schattenlanze für die erste Zielauswahl <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> nicht ausgewählt und teleportiert sich zum entferntesten Gegner.

th.name: ชาโดว์สไตรค์
th.description: อาบไล้หอกไว้ด้วยพลังแห่งรูปเงา ทิ่มแทงเข้าสู่ร่างกายของศัตรู
th.detailDescription: เพิกเฉยต่อการหลบหลีกของศัตรูและโจมตีด้วยความเสียหายเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ DPS ของฮันเตอร์ พร้อมทำให้ศัตรูติดสตันเป็นเวลา <color=#46CCFF>valueTime วินาที</color> เมื่อเริ่มการต่อสู้ PvP ชาโดว์แลนเซอร์จะไม่ถูกเลือกเป็นเป้าหมายโจมตีแรกนาน <color=#46CCFF>keepTime วิ</color> และจะเทเลพอร์ตไปยังศัตรูที่อยู่ห่างออกไปที่สุด

vi.name: Đột Kích Bóng Đêm
vi.description: Dồn toàn bộ sức mạnh của bóng tối và đâm thẳng vào cơ thể kẻ địch.
vi.detailDescription: Tấn công và bỏ qua né tránh của địch với sát thương bằng <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS của bản thân, gây choáng trong <color=#46CCFF>valueTime giây</color>. Thương thủ Bóng tối khi bắt đầu nội dung PVP, sẽ không bị chọn làm mục tiêu trong <color=#46CCFF>keepTime</color> giây ở lần kích hoạt đầu tiên, và ngay lập tức dịch chuyển đến kẻ địch ở xa nhất.

id.name: Serangan Bayangan
id.description: Memberikan kekuatan bayangan pada tombak, menusukkannya ke dalam tubuh musuh.
id.detailDescription: Abaikan penghindaran musuh dan serang mereka dengan kerusakan setara dengan <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> dari DPS pemburu dan stun mereka selama <color=#46CCFF>valueTime detik</color>. Di awal pertandingan PvP, Lancer Bayangan tidak akan dipilih untuk penargetan pertama selama <color=#46CCFF>keepTime detik</color>, dan akan teleport ke musuh terjauh.

ko.name: 스핀 스플래시
ko.description: 일반공격시 확률적으로 스핀 스플래시를 시전한다.
ko.detailDescription: 일반공격시 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 확률로 스핀 스플래시 시전. 스핀 스플래시는 <color=#46CCFF>keepTime초</color> 동안 초당 공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 데미지로 <color=#46CCFF>valueTime초</color>마다 방어력을 무시하고 광역공격. (시전 후 <color=#46CCFF>2초</color>간 시전불가)

ja.name: スピンスプラッシュ
ja.description: 通常攻撃時、確率的にスピンスプラッシュを発動する。
ja.detailDescription: 一般攻撃時、 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> の確率で、スピンスプラッシュ発動。スピンスプラッシュは、 <color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color> 間、毎秒攻撃力の <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> のダメージで <color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>ごとに防御力を無視して広域攻撃。(発動後 <color=#46CCFF>2秒</color>間、発動不可)

en.name: Spin Splash
en.description: Has a chance to cast Spin Splash during normal attacks.
en.detailDescription: During normal attacks, Spin Splash is cast at a <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> chance. For <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>, Spin Splash ignores the DEF and deals AoE attacks with damage equal to <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of the DPS every <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. (Cannot be activated for <color=#46CCFF>2 sec</color> after casting)

zh-TW.name: 旋轉飛濺
zh-TW.description: 普通攻擊時有機會施展旋轉飛濺。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 普通攻擊時以<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的機率施展旋轉飛濺。<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間, 旋轉飛濺每<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>將無視防禦力並以每秒攻擊力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的傷害進行廣域攻擊。(發動後的<color=#46CCFF>2秒</color>間無法施展)

zh-CN.name: 旋转飞溅
zh-CN.description: 普通攻击时有机会施展旋转飞溅。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 普通攻击时以<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的概率施展旋转飞溅。<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>间, 旋转飞溅每<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>将无视防御力并以每秒攻击力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的伤害进行广域攻击。(发动后的<color=#46CCFF>2秒</color>间无法施展)

ru.name: Вращающийся всплеск
ru.description: Имеет шанс использовать Вихревой Всплеск во время обычных атак.
ru.detailDescription: Во время обычных атак Вращающийся всплеск накладывается с шансом <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>. В течение <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> Вращающийся всплеск игнорирует ЗАЩ и наносит AoE-атаки с уроном, равным <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> от УвС каждые <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. (Не может быть активирован в течение <color=#46CCFF>2 sec</color> после кастования)

fr.name: Splash tournoyant
fr.description: A une chance de lancer Splash tournoyant lors des attaques normales.
fr.detailDescription: Lors des attaques normales, Splash tournoyant est lancé avec une chance de <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>. Pendant <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>, Splash tournoyant ignore la DEF et inflige des dégâts de zone égaux à <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> du DPS toutes les <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. (Ne peut pas être réactivée pendant <color=#46CCFF>2 sec</color> après son lancement.)

es.name: Salpicadura Giratoria
es.description: Tiene la oportunidad de lanzar Salpicadura Giratoria durante los ataques normales.
es.detailDescription: Durante los ataques normales, Salpicadura Giratoria se lanza con un <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de probabilidad. Durante <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>, Salpicadura Giratoria ignora el DEF y realiza ataques AoE con un daño igual al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS cada <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. (No se puede activar durante <color=#46CCFF>2 sec</color> después de lanzar)

pt.name: Splash Giratório
pt.description: Tem uma chance de conjurar Splash Giratório em ataques normais.
pt.detailDescription: Durante ataques normais, o Splash Giratório é lançado com uma chance de <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>. Por <color=#46CCFF>keepTime seg</color>, o Splash Giratório ignora a DEF e causa dano em área igual a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> do DPS a cada <color=#46CCFF>valueTime seg</color>. (Não pode ser reativado por <color=#46CCFF>2 seg</color> após ser lançado.)

it.name: Splash Rotante
it.description: Ha la possibilità di lanciare Splash Rotante durante gli attacchi normali.
it.detailDescription: Durante gli attacchi normali, Splash Rotante viene lanciato con una probabilità del <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>. Per <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>, Splash Rotante ignora il DEF e infligge attacchi AoE con danni pari a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS ogni <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. (Non può essere attivato per <color=#46CCFF>2 sec</color> dopo il lancio)

de.name: Dreh-Splash
de.description: Hat die Chance, Dreh-Splash während normaler Angriffe zu wirken.
de.detailDescription: Während normaler Angriffe wird Dreh-Splash mit einer <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> Chance gewirkt. Für <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> ignoriert Dreh-Splash die DEF und verursacht AoE-Angriffe mit einem Schaden, der <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des DPS alle <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color> entspricht. (Kann nach dem Wirken für <color=#46CCFF>2 sec</color> nicht aktiviert werden)

th.name: สปินสแปลช
th.description: มีโอกาสสปินสแปลชระหว่างการโจมตีปกติ
th.detailDescription: ระหว่างการโจมตีปกติ จะมีโอกาสใช้สปินสแปลช <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> ในระยะเวลา <color=#46CCFF>keepTime วิ</color> สปินสแปลชเพิกเฉยต่อ DEF และโจมตีเป็นวงกว้าง สร้างความเสียหายเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ DPS ทุกๆ <color=#46CCFF>valueTime วิ</color> (เปิดใช้งานไม่ได้นาน <color=#46CCFF>2 วิ</color> หลังการร่าย)

vi.name: Xoáy Trảm
vi.description: Khi tấn công thường, thi triển Xoáy Trảm theo tỉ lệ.
vi.detailDescription: Khi tấn công thường, Kỹ năng Xoáy Trảm được thi triển với tỉ lệ <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>. Trong <color=#46CCFF>keepTime giây</color>, Xoáy Trảm bỏ qua DEF và tấn công diện rộng với sát thương bằng <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS cứ mỗi <color=#46CCFF>valueTime giây</color>. (Không thể kích hoạt trong <color=#46CCFF>2 giây</color> sau khi thi triển)

id.name: Putaran Percikan
id.description: Memiliki kesempatan untuk menggunakan Putaran Percikan selama serangan normal.
id.detailDescription: Selama serangan normal, Putaran Percikan dilemparkan dengan peluang <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>. Selama <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>, Putaran Percikan mengabaikan DEF dan memberikan serangan AoE dengan damage setara dengan <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> dari DPS setiap <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. (Tidak dapat diaktifkan selama <color=#46CCFF>2 sec</color> setelah dilemparkan)

ko.name: 피어싱 쓰러스트
ko.description: 창을 깊게 찔러넣어 적들을 관통하고 방패로 방어를 견고히 한다.
ko.detailDescription: 자신의 초당 공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 데미지로 광역공격. 스킬 범위 내에 위치한 적 1명당 시전자의 받는 피해 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 감소. (최대 <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color>중첩) 받는 피해 감소 효과는 <color=#46CCFF>keepTime초</color>간 지속.

ja.name: ピアシングスラスト
ja.description: 槍を深く突き刺して敵を貫通し、盾で防御を堅固にする。
ja.detailDescription: 自身の毎秒の攻撃力の<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ダメージで広域攻撃。スキル範囲内にいる敵1体につき、発動者が受けるダメージが<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 減少。(最大 <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color>重複) 受けるダメージ減少効果は <color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間持続。

en.name: Piercing Thrust
en.description: Thrusts the spear deeply, piercing enemies and reinforcing defense with a shield.
en.detailDescription: Cast an AoE attack with damage equal to <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of the hunter's DPS. The damage taken by the caster is reduced by <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> for every enemy within range of the skill. (Stacks up to <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> times) The damage reduction effect lasts for <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>.

zh-TW.name: 刺穿猛擊
zh-TW.description: 將矛深深刺向敵人並刺穿，且以盾牌加強防禦。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 以自身每秒攻擊力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的傷害進行廣域攻擊。每1名位在技能範圍內的敵人, 讓施展者受到的傷害減少<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>。(最多疊加<color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color>次)受到傷害減少效果將持續<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>。

zh-CN.name: 刺穿猛击
zh-CN.description: 将矛深深刺向敌人并刺穿，且以盾牌加强防御。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 以自身每秒攻击力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的伤害进行广域攻击。每1名位在技能范围内的敌人, 让施展者受到的伤害减少<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>。(最多叠加<color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color>次)受到伤害减少效果将持续<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>。

ru.name: Проникающий удар
ru.description: Глубоко вонзает копье, пронзая врагов и усиливая защиту щитом.
ru.detailDescription: Нанесите AoE-атаку с уроном, равным <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> от УвС охотника. Урон, получаемый заклинателем, уменьшается на <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> за каждого врага в радиусе действия навыка. (Суммируется до <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> раз) Эффект уменьшения урона длится <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>.

fr.name: Poussée perforante
fr.description: Enfonce profondément la lance, transperçant les ennemis et renforçant sa défense avec un bouclier.
fr.detailDescription: Lance une attaque de zone infligeant des dégâts égaux à <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des DPS du chasseur. Les dégâts subis par le lanceur sont réduits de <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> pour chaque ennemi à portée de la compétence. (Cumulable jusqu'à <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> fois) L'effet de réduction des dégâts dure <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>.

es.name: Estocada Perforante
es.description: Clava la lanza profundamente, atravesando a los enemigos y reforzando la defensa con un escudo.
es.detailDescription: Lanza un ataque de área con un daño igual al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS del cazador. El daño recibido por el lanzador se reduce en <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> por cada enemigo dentro del alcance de la habilidad. (Se acumula hasta <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> veces) El efecto de reducción de daño dura <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>.

pt.name: Empurrão Perfurante
pt.description: Crava a lança profundamente, perfurando inimigos e reforçando sua defesa com um escudo.
pt.detailDescription: Lança um ataque em área que causa dano equivalente a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> do DPS do caçador. O dano recebido pelo lançador é reduzido em <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> para cada inimigo dentro do alcance da habilidade. (Acumulável até <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> vezes) O efeito de redução de dano dura <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>.

it.name: Colpo Pungente
it.description: Trafigge profondamente con la lancia, perforando i nemici e rinforzando la difesa con uno scudo.
it.detailDescription: Lancia un attacco AoE con danni pari a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS del cacciatore. I danni subiti dal lanciatore sono ridotti del <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> per ogni nemico entro il raggio dell'abilità. (Accumula fino a <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> volte) L'effetto di riduzione dei danni dura per <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>.

de.name: Durchdringender Stoß
de.description: Durchbohrt die Feinde tief mit dem Speer und verstärkt die Verteidigung mit einem Schild.
de.detailDescription: Wirf einen AoE-Angriff mit einem Schaden, der <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des DPS des Jägers entspricht. Der vom Zaubernden erlittene Schaden wird um <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> für jeden Feind im Bereich des Skills reduziert. (Stapelbar bis zu <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> Mal) Der Schadensreduzierungseffekt hält <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> an.

th.name: เพีร์ซซิ่งทรัสท์
th.description: แทงหอกลึกทะลุร่างศัตรู และเสริมการป้องกันด้วยโล่
th.detailDescription: ใช้การโจมตีเป็นวงกว้างเพื่อสร้างความเสียหายเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ DPS ของฮันเตอร์ ความเสียหายที่ผู้ร่ายได้รับลดลง <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> ต่อจำนวนศัตรูที่อยู่ในขอบเขตสกิล (ซ้อนทับสูงสุด <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> ครั้ง) เอฟเฟกต์ลดความเสียหายทำงานนาน <color=#46CCFF>keepTime วิ</color>

vi.name: Đâm Xuyên Phá
vi.description: Đâm sâu mũi thương xuyên qua kẻ địch và củng cố phòng thủ bằng khiên.
vi.detailDescription: Thi triển đòn tấn công diện rộng với sát thương bằng <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS của bản thân. Sát thương phải nhận vào của người thi triển với mỗi 1 kẻ địch nằm trong phạm vi kỹ năng giảm <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>. (Cộng dồn tối đa <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> lần) Hiệu ứng giảm sát thương duy trì trong <color=#46CCFF>keepTime giây</color>

id.name: Tusukan Menembus
id.description: Menusukkan tombak dengan dalam, menembus musuh dan memperkuat pertahanan dengan perisai.
id.detailDescription: Lakukan serangan AoE dengan damage setara dengan <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> dari DPS pemburu. Damage yang diterima oleh caster dikurangi sebesar <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> untuk setiap musuh dalam jangkauan keterampilan. (Bisa ditumpuk hingga <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> kali) Efek pengurangan damage bertahan selama <color=#46CCFF>keepTime detik</color>.

ko.name: 셰이드 자벨린
ko.description: 망령의 힘을 담은 창을 투창하여 적을 공포에 빠뜨린다.
ko.detailDescription: 자신의 초당 공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 데미지로 적의 회피를 무시하고 공격, 적을 <color=#46CCFF>valueTime초</color> 동안 패닉

ja.name: シェードジャベリン
ja.description: 亡霊の力を込めた槍を投げて、敵を恐怖に陥れる。
ja.detailDescription: 自身の毎秒の攻撃力の <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> のダメージで敵の回避を無視して攻撃、敵を <color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>間、パニック状態にする。

en.name: Shade Javelin
en.description: Throws a spear imbued with the power of wraiths, instilling terror in the enemy.
en.detailDescription: Attacks the enemy with damage equal to <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of the hunter's DPS. The attack ignores the enemy's evasion and makes them panic for <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>.

zh-TW.name: 幽暗投槍
zh-TW.description: 投擲蘊含亡靈之力的矛, 使敵人深陷恐懼。
zh-TW.detailDescription: 無視敵人的閃避並以自身每秒攻擊力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的傷害進行攻擊並使其陷入恐慌<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>

zh-CN.name: 幽暗投枪
zh-CN.description: 投掷蕴含亡灵之力的矛, 使敌人深陷恐惧。
zh-CN.detailDescription: 无视敌人的闪避并以自身每秒攻击力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的伤害进行攻击并使其陷入恐慌<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>

ru.name: Тень Дартс
ru.description: Бросает копье, наделенное силой призраков, внушая ужас врагу.
ru.detailDescription: Атакует врага с уроном, равным <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> УвС охотника. Атака игнорирует уклонение врага и вызывает у него панику на <color=#46CCFF>valueTime сек</color>.

fr.name: Javelot de l'ombre
fr.description: Lance une lance imprégnée du pouvoir des spectres, semant la terreur chez l'ennemi.
fr.detailDescription: Attaque avec des dégâts égaux à <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> du DPS du chasseur, ignore l’esquive de l’ennemi et le fait paniquer pendant <color=#46CCFF>valueTime s</color>.

es.name: Jabalina de Sombra
es.description: Lanza una lanza imbuida con el poder de los espectros, infundiendo terror en el enemigo.
es.detailDescription: Ataca al enemigo con un daño igual al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS del cazador. El ataque ignora la evasión del enemigo y hace que entre en pánico durante <color=#46CCFF>valueTime seg</color>.

pt.name: Dardo Sombrio
pt.description: Empunha uma lança imbuída com o poder dos espectros, semeando terror entre os inimigos.
pt.detailDescription: Ataca com dano igual a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> do DPS do caçador, ignora a evasão do inimigo e causa pânico por <color=#46CCFF>valueTime s</color>.

it.name: Giavellotto d'Ombra
it.description: Lancia una lancia imbevuta del potere dei fantasmi, instillando terrore nel nemico.
it.detailDescription: Attacca il nemico con danni pari a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS del cacciatore. L'attacco ignora l'evasione del nemico e lo fa andare in panico per <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>.

de.name: Schatten-Javelin
de.description: Wirft einen Speer, der mit der Macht der Gespenster durchtränkt ist und dem Feind Angst einflößt.
de.detailDescription: Greift den Feind mit einem Schaden an, der <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> der SPS des Jägers entspricht. Der Angriff ignoriert die Ausweichchance des Feindes und versetzt ihn für <color=#46CCFF>valueTime Sek.</color> in Panik.

th.name: เชดจาเวลิน
th.description: ขว้างหอกที่บรรจุพลังของเหล่าภูตผี ทำให้ศัตรูขวัญผวา
th.detailDescription: โจมตีศัตรู สร้างความเสียหายเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ ATK / sec ของฮันเตอร์ การโจมตีนี้เพิกเฉยต่อการหลบหลีกของศัตรูและทำให้ศัตรูตระหนกนาน <color=#46CCFF>valueTime วิ</color>

vi.name: Thương Bóng Ảnh
vi.description: Ném cây thương mang sức mạnh của vong linh, gieo rắc nỗi kinh hoàng cho kẻ địch.
vi.detailDescription: Tấn công bỏ qua né tránh của kẻ thù với sát thương bằng <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS của bản thân, khiến kẻ thù rơi vào trạng thái hoảng loạn trong <color=#46CCFF>valueTime giây</color>

id.name: Javelin Bayangan
id.description: Melempar sebuah tombak yang diberdayakan dengan kekuatan wraith, menanamkan teror pada musuh.
id.detailDescription: Menyerang musuh dengan kerusakan setara dengan <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> dari DPS pemburu. Serangan ini mengabaikan penghindaran musuh dan membuatnya panik selama <color=#46CCFF>valueTime detik</color>.

ko.name: 드래곤 브레스
ko.description: 탑승중인 용의 입에서 브레스를 뿜어 적을 불태운다.
ko.detailDescription: <color=#46CCFF>keepTime초</color> 동안 자신의 초당 공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 데미지로 <color=#46CCFF>valueTime초</color>마다 광역공격. 드래곤 브레스 시전 중에는 행동불가 상태이상에 면역.

ja.name: ドラゴンブレス
ja.description: 搭乗中のドラゴンの口からブレスを噴射し、敵を焼き尽くす。
ja.detailDescription: <color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color> 間、自身の毎秒の攻撃力の <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> のダメージで <color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>ごとに広域攻撃。ドラゴンブレス発動中には、行動不能の状態異常に免疫。

en.name: Dragon Breath
en.description: Unleashes a fiery breath from the mounted dragon's mouth to burn enemies.
en.detailDescription: For <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>, deal AoE attacks with damage equal to <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of the hunter's DPS every <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. When casting Dragon Breath, become immune to status effects that limit actions.

zh-TW.name: 龍息
zh-TW.description: 所騎乘的龍口中吐出氣息來燃燒敵人。
zh-TW.detailDescription: <color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間, 每<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>以自身每秒攻擊力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的傷害進行廣域攻擊。施展龍息中對無法行動的異常狀態免疫。

zh-CN.name: 龙息
zh-CN.description: 所骑乘的龙口中吐出气息来燃烧敌人。
zh-CN.detailDescription: <color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>间, 每<color=#46CCFF>valueTime秒</color>以自身每秒攻击力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的伤害进行广域攻击。施展龙息中对无法行动的异常状态免疫。

ru.name: Дыхание дракона
ru.description: Выпускает огненное дыхание из пасти дракона, чтобы сжечь врагов.
ru.detailDescription: В течение <color=#46CCFF>keepTime сек</color> наносите AoE-атаки с уроном, равным <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> от УвС охотника каждые <color=#46CCFF>valueTime сек</color>. При использовании Драконьего Дыхания становитесьimmune к статусным эффектам, ограничивающим действия.

fr.name: Souffle du dragon
fr.description: Crache un souffle ardent depuis la gueule du dragon monté pour brûler les ennemis.
fr.detailDescription: Pendant <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>, inflige des attaques de zone infligeant des dégâts égaux à <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> du DPS du chasseur toutes les <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. Lorsque vous utilisez Souffle du dragon, vous devenez immunisé contre l'effet d'état qui limite les actions.

es.name: Aliento de Dragón
es.description: Desata un aliento ardiente desde la boca del dragón montado para quemar a los enemigos.
es.detailDescription: Durante <color=#46CCFF>keepTime seg</color>, realiza ataques AoE con daño igual a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS del cazador cada <color=#46CCFF>valueTime seg</color>. Al lanzar Aliento de Dragón, te vuelves inmune a los efectos de estado que limitan acciones.

pt.name: Sopro do Dragão
pt.description: Cospe um hálito flamejante da boca do dragão montado para incinerar inimigos.
pt.detailDescription: Por <color=#46CCFF>keepTime seg</color>, causa ataques em área (AoE) com dano equivalente a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> do DPS do caçador a cada <color=#46CCFF>valueTime seg</color>. Ao usar Sopro do Dragão, você se torna imune ao efeito de status que restringe ações.

it.name: Alito di Drago
it.description: Scatena un soffio infuocato dalla bocca del drago montato per bruciare i nemici.
it.detailDescription: Per <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color>, infliggi attacchi AoE con danno pari a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS del cacciatore ogni <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. Quando lanci Alito di Drago, diventi immune agli effetti di stato che limitano le azioni.

de.name: Drachenodem
de.description: Entfesselt einen feurigen Atem aus dem Maul des gerittenen Drachen, um Feinde zu verbrennen.
de.detailDescription: Für <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> verursache AoE-Angriffe mit einem Schaden, der <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des DPS des Jägers entspricht, alle <color=#46CCFF>valueTime sec</color>. Beim Wirken von Drachenodem werde immun gegen Status-Effekte, die Aktionen einschränken.

th.name: ดรากอนเบรธ
th.description: ปลดปล่อยลมหายใจร้อนระอุจากปากของมังกรที่ขี่อยู่เพื่อเผาศัตรู
th.detailDescription: ในระยะเวลา <color=#46CCFF>keepTime วิ</color> โจมตีเป็นวงกว้างสร้างความเสียหายเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ DPS ของฮันเตอร์ทุกๆ <color=#46CCFF>valueTime วิ</color> เมื่อใช้ดรากอนเบรธ จะมีภูมิคุ้มกันต่อเอฟเฟกต์สถานะที่จำกัดการกระทำ

vi.name: Hơi Thở Rồng
vi.description: Rồng mà bạn đang cưỡi phun luồng hơi nóng thổi thiêu kẻ địch.
vi.detailDescription: Trong <color=#46CCFF>keepTime giây</color>, cứ mỗi <color=#46CCFF>valueTime giây</color> tấn công diện rộng với sát thương bằng <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS bản thân. Khi thi triển Hơi Thở Rồng, được miễn nhiễm với các hiệu ứng trạng thái giới hạn hành động.

id.name: Napas Naga
id.description: Mengeluarkan napas berapi dari mulut naga yang ditunggangi untuk membakar musuh.
id.detailDescription: Selama <color=#46CCFF>keepTime detik</color>, lakukan serangan AoE dengan damage setara dengan <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> dari DPS pemburu setiap <color=#46CCFF>valueTime detik</color>. Saat mengeluarkan Napas Naga, menjadi kebal terhadap efek status yang membatasi tindakan.

ko.name: 하이퍼 블리츠
ko.description: 일반공격시 확률적으로 하이퍼 블리츠를 시전한다.
ko.detailDescription:
일반공격시 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 확률로 초당공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 데미지로 <color=#46CCFF>valueCount회</color> 광역공격. 하이퍼 블리츠는 적의 방어력을 무시. 
(PVP에서 스킬공격력 60% 감폭)

ja.name: ハイパーブリッツ
ja.description: 通常攻撃時、確率的にハイパーブリッツを発動する。
ja.detailDescription:
一般攻撃時<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> の確率で毎秒の攻撃力の <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> のダメージで <color=#46CCFF>valueCount回</color> 広域攻撃。ハイパーブリッツは、敵の防御力を無視する。
$(PVPでは、スキル攻撃力 60% 縮小)$

en.name: Hyper Blitz
en.description: Has a chance to cast Hyper Blitz during normal attacks.
en.detailDescription:
During normal attacks, there is a <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> chance to cast <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> AoE attack(s) with damage equal to <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of the DPS. Hyper Blitz ignores the enemy's DEF.
$(Skill ATK is deamplified by 60% in PvP)$

zh-TW.name: 極度閃擊
zh-TW.description: 普通攻擊時有機會施展極度閃擊。
zh-TW.detailDescription:
普通攻擊時, 有<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的機率以每秒攻擊力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的傷害進行<color=#46CCFF>valueCount次</color>廣域攻擊。極度閃擊將無視敵人的防禦力。
$(PvP中技能攻擊力下降60%)$

zh-CN.name: 极度闪击
zh-CN.description: 普通攻击时有机会施展极度闪击。
zh-CN.detailDescription:
普通攻击时, 有<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的概率以每秒攻击力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的伤害进行<color=#46CCFF>valueCount次</color>广域攻击。极度闪击将无视敌人的防御力。
$(PvP中技能攻击力下降60%)$

ru.name: Гипер Блиц
ru.description: Имеет шанс применить Гипер Блиц во время обычных атак.
ru.detailDescription:
Во время обычных атак есть <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> шанс выполнить <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> AoE-атаку(и) с уроном, равным <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> от УвС. Гипер Блиц игнорирует защиту врага.
$(ATK навыка понижается на 60% в PvP)$

fr.name: Blitz intense
fr.description: A une chance de lancer Blitz intense lors des attaques normales.
fr.detailDescription:
Lors des attaques normales, il y a <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> chance de lancer <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> attaque(s) de zone infligeant des dégâts égaux à <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des DPS. Blitz intense ignore la DEF de l'ennemi.
$(L'ATQ de la compétence est déamplifié de 60% en JcJ)$

es.name: Hiper Blitz
es.description: Tiene la oportunidad de lanzar Hiper Blitz durante los ataques normales.
es.detailDescription:
Durante los ataques normales, hay un <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de probabilidad de lanzar <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> ataque(s) en área con daño igual a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS. Hiper Blitz ignora la DEF del enemigo.
$(El ATQ de la Habilidad se desamplifica en un 60% en PvP)$

pt.name: Blitz Intenso
pt.description: Tem uma chance de conjurar Blitz Intenso em ataques normais.
pt.detailDescription:
Ao atacar normalmente, há <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> de chance de lançar <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> ataque(s) em área que causam dano equivalente a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> do DPS. Blitz Intenso ignora a DEF do inimigo.
$(O ATQ da habilidade é desamplificado em 60% em PvP)$

it.name: Hyper Blitz
it.description: Ha una possibilità di lanciare Hyper Blitz durante gli attacchi normali.
it.detailDescription:
Durante gli attacchi normali, c'è una <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> possibilità di lanciare <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> attacco(i) AoE con danno pari a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS. Hyper Blitz ignora la DEF del nemico.
$(Abilità ATK è de-amplificato del 60% in PvP)$

de.name: Hyper Blitz
de.description: Hat die Chance, Hyper Blitz während normaler Angriffe zu wirken.
de.detailDescription:
Bei normalen Angriffen gibt es eine <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> Chance, <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> AoE-Angriff(e) mit einem Schaden zu verursachen, der <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des DPS entspricht. Hyper Blitz ignoriert die DEF des Gegners.
$(Fertigkeits-ANG wird im PvP um 60% geschwächt)$

th.name: ไฮเปอร์บลิตซ์
th.description: มีโอกาสร่ายไฮเปอร์บลิตซ์ระหว่างการโจมตีปกติ
th.detailDescription:
ระหว่างการโจมตีปกติ มีโอกาส <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> ที่จะร่ายการโจมตีเป็นวงกว้าง <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> ครั้ง สร้างความเสียหายเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ DPS ไฮเปอร์บลิตซ์เพิกเฉย DEF ของศัตรู
$(ATK สกิลหดลง 60% ใน PvP)$

vi.name: Tốc Kích Tối Đa
vi.description: Khi tấn công thường thi triển Tốc Kích Tối Đa theo tỉ lệ
vi.detailDescription: Khi tấn công thường, có <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> tỉ lệ thi triển <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> đòn tấn công diện rộng với sát thương bằng <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS. Tốc Kích Tối Đa bỏ qua DEF của kẻ địch. $(ATK Kỹ năng bị giảm mạnh 60% trong PVP)$

id.name: Hyper Blitz
id.description: Memiliki kesempatan untuk melempar Hyper Blitz selama serangan normal.
id.detailDescription:
Selama serangan normal, ada <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> kemungkinan untuk melancarkan <color=#46CCFF>valueCount</color> serangan AoE dengan damage setara dengan <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> dari DPS. Hyper Blitz mengabaikan DEF musuh.
$(ATK Skill dilemahkan 60% di PvP)$

ko.name: 미스틸테인
ko.description: 저주의 창 미스틸테인을 소환하여 강력한 저주를 내린다.
ko.detailDescription:
초당공격력의 <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> 데미지로 광역공격. <color=#46CCFF>keepTime초</color>간 저주지역을 생성해 범위 내 적에게 지속적으로 치명타 공격으로 받는 피해 <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 증가 상태이상 부여. 
(PVP에서 스킬공격력 60% 감폭)

ja.name: ミステルテイン
ja.description: 呪いの槍ミステルテインを召喚し、強力な呪いをかける。
ja.detailDescription:
毎秒攻撃力の<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> のダメージで広域攻撃。<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間、呪いエリアを生成し、範囲内の敵に持続的にクリティカル攻撃で与えるダメージ <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> 増加、状態異常付与。
$(PVPでは、スキル攻撃力 60% 縮小)$

en.name: Mistilteinn
en.description: Summons the cursed spear Mistilteinn to unleash a powerful curse.
en.detailDescription:
Cast an AoE attack with damage equal to <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> of the DPS. Create a cursed area for <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> that grants enemies within range a status effect that increases the damage taken from critical hits by <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>.
$(Skill ATK is deamplified by 60% in PvP)$

zh-TW.name: 米斯特汀
zh-TW.description: 召喚詛咒之矛－米斯特汀並施放強大的詛咒。
zh-TW.detailDescription:
以每秒攻擊力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的傷害進行廣域攻擊。<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>間生成詛咒區域, 持續對範圍內的敵人賦予所受致命一擊的傷害增加<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的異常狀態。
$(PvP中技能攻擊力下降60%)$

zh-CN.name: 米斯特汀
zh-CN.description: 召唤诅咒之矛－米斯特汀并施放强大的诅咒。
zh-CN.detailDescription:
以每秒攻击力<color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color>的伤害进行广域攻击。<color=#46CCFF>keepTime秒</color>间生成诅咒区域, 持续对范围内的敌人赋予所受致命一击的伤害增加<color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>的异常状态。
$(PvP中技能攻击力下降60%)$

ru.name: Мистильтейн
ru.description: Призывает проклятое копье Мистильтейн, чтобы наложить мощное проклятие.
ru.detailDescription:
Нанесите AoE-атаку с уроном, равным <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> от УвС. Создайте проклятую область на <color=#46CCFF>keepTime сек</color>, которая дает врагам в пределах досягаемости статусный эффект, увеличивающий получаемый урон от критических ударов на <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>.
$(ATK навыка понижается на 60% в PvP)$

fr.name: Mistilteinn
fr.description: Invoque la lance maudite Mistilteinn pour libérer une puissante malédiction.
fr.detailDescription:
Lance une attaque de zone infligeant des dégâts égaux à <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> du DPS. Créez une zone maudite pendant <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> qui confère aux ennemis à portée un effet d'état augmentant les dégâts CRIT subis de <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>.
$(L'ATQ de la compétence est déamplifié de 60% en JcJ)$

es.name: Mistilteinn
es.description: Invoca la lanza maldita Mistilteinn para desatar una poderosa maldición.
es.detailDescription:
Lanza un ataque de área con daño igual al <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS. Crea un área maldita durante <color=#46CCFF>keepTime seg</color> que otorga a los enemigos dentro del alcance un efecto de estado que aumenta el daño recibido de golpes críticos en un <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>.
$(El ATQ de la Habilidad se desamplifica en un 60% en PvP)$

pt.name: Mistilteinn
pt.description: Invoca a lança amaldiçoada Mistilteinn para liberar uma poderosa maldição.
pt.detailDescription:
Lança um ataque em área que causa dano equivalente a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> do DPS. Cria uma zona amaldiçoada por <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> que aplica um efeito de status aos inimigos no alcance, aumentando o dano CRÍT recebido em <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>.
$(O ATQ da habilidade é desamplificado em 60% em PvP)$

it.name: Mistilteinn
it.description: Evoca la lancia maledetta Mistilteinn per scatenare una potente maledizione.
it.detailDescription:
Lancia un attacco AoE con danno pari a <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> del DPS. Crea un'area maledetta per <color=#46CCFF>keepTime sec</color> che concede ai nemici entro portata un effetto di stato che aumenta il danno subito dai colpi critici del <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>.
$(Abilità ATK è de-amplificato del 60% in PvP)$

de.name: Mistilteinn
de.description: Beschwört den verfluchten Speer Mistilteinn, um einen mächtigen Fluch zu entfesseln.
de.detailDescription:
Wirf einen AoE-Angriff mit einem Schaden, der <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> des DPS entspricht. Erstelle ein verfluchtes Gebiet für <color=#46CCFF>keepTime Sek.</color>, das Feinden im Bereich einen Status-Effekt gewährt, der den erlittenen Schaden durch kritische Treffer um <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> erhöht.
$(Fertigkeits-ANG wird im PvP um 60% geschwächt)$

th.name: มิสทิลเทน
th.description: เรียกหอกต้องสาปมิสทิลเทนเพื่อปลดปล่อยคำสาปทรงพลัง
th.detailDescription:
ใช้การโจมตีเป็นวงกว้างเพื่อสร้างความเสียหายเท่ากับ <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> ของ DPS สร้างอาณาเขตคำสาปขึ้น <color=#46CCFF>keepTime วิ</color> ทำให้ศัตรูที่อยู่ภายในติดเอฟเฟกต์สถานะซึ่งจะเพิ่มความเสียหายที่ได้รับจากการโจมตีคริติคอลขึ้น <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>
$(ATK สกิลหดลง 60% ใน PvP)$

vi.name: Mistilteinn
vi.description: Triệu hồi cây thương bị nguyền Mistilteinn để giáng xuống lời nguyền mạnh mẽ.
vi.detailDescription: Thi triển đòn tấn công diện rộng với sát thương bằng <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> DPS. Tạo ra một vùng đất nguyền rủa trong <color=#46CCFF>keepTime giây</color>, gây hiệu ứng trạng thái làm tăng <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color> sát thương CRIT phải nhận cho kẻ địch trong phạm vi. $(ATK Kỹ năng bị giảm mạnh 60% trong PVP)$

id.name: Mistilteinn
id.description: Memanggil tombak terkutuk Mistilteinn untuk melepaskan kutukan yang kuat.
id.detailDescription:
Lakukan serangan AoE dengan damage setara dengan <color=#46CCFF>keepValue%</color> dari DPS. Buat area terkutuk selama <color=#46CCFF>keepTime detik</color> yang memberikan efek status kepada musuh dalam jangkauan yang meningkatkan damage yang diterima dari serangan kritis sebesar <color=#46CCFF>secondValue%</color>.
$(ATK Skill dilemahkan 60% di PvP)$

$(Augmentation est déamplifié de 70% en JcJ)$

オーラブレイドの防御・回避無視攻撃が命中すると、secondValue秒間、負傷悪化の状態異常デバフを適用する。
負傷悪化の状態異常は、対象に発動される体力回復効果・シールドのダメージ吸収量をfirstValue%減幅する。

en.title: Open Wound
en.description: Aura Blade leaves a wound that is hard to heal.
en.detailDescription:
When Aura Blade's DEF/evasion-ignoring strike hits the target, the Open Wound status effect is applied for secondValue sec.
The Open Wound status effect deamplifies the HP recovery effect and damage absorption effect of shields cast on the target by firstValue%

zh-TW.title: 傷口惡化
zh-TW.description: 光之刃留下難以治癒的傷口。
zh-TW.detailDescription:
光之刃的無視防禦和閃避一擊擊中時, secondValue秒間會套用傷口惡化異常狀態。
傷口惡化異常狀態讓套用在目標的體力恢復效果和保護罩的傷害吸取量下降firstValue%。

zh-CN.title: 伤口恶化
zh-CN.description: 光之刃留下难以治愈的伤口。
zh-CN.detailDescription:
光之刃的无视防御和闪避一击击中时, secondValue秒间会套用伤口恶化异常状态。
伤口恶化异常状态让套用在目标的体力恢复效果和保护罩的伤害吸取量下降firstValue%。

ru.title: Открытая Рана
ru.description: Клинок Ауры оставляет рану, которую трудно залечить.
ru.detailDescription:
Когда удар Клинок Ауры с понижением ЗАЩ/Уклонения попадает по цели, накладывается статус эффект Открытая Рана на secondValue сек.
Статус эффект Открытая Рана понижает эффект восс. ОЗ и поглощения урона от щитов, наложенных на цель, на firstValue%.

fr.title: Plaie ouverte
fr.description: Aura de la lame laisse une blessure difficile à soigner.
fr.detailDescription:
Lorsque la frappe de l'aura de la lame affectant la DEF/évasion touche la cible, l'effet de statut de plaie ouverte est appliqué pendant secondValue secondes.
L'effet de statut de la plaie ouverte déamplifie l'effet de récupération des PV et l'effet d'absorption des dégâts des boucliers lancés sur la cible de firstValue%.

es.title: Herida Abierta
es.description: Hoja del Aura deja una herida difícil de curar.
es.detailDescription:
Cuando el golpe que ignora la DEF y evasión de la Cuchilla de Aura alcanza al objetivo, se aplica el efecto de estado Herida Abierta durante secondValue seg.
El efecto de estado Herida Abierta desamplifica el efecto de recuperación de HP y el efecto de absorción del daño de los escudos lanzados contra el objetivo en un firstValue%.

pt.title: Ferida aberta
pt.description: Aura da lama deixa um ferimento difícil de curar.
pt.detailDescription:
Quando o ataque da aura de lâmina que afeta a DEF/evasão atinge o alvo, o efeito de status da ferida aberta é aplicado por secondValue segundos.
O efeito de status da ferida aberta desamplifica o efeito de recuperação de HP e o efeito de absorção de dano dos escudos lançados no alvo de firstValue%.

it.title: Ferita aperta
it.description: Aura della Spada lascia una ferita difficile da guarire.
it.detailDescription:
Quando il colpo che ignora la DEF e l'evasione dell'Aura della Spada colpisce il bersaglio, viene applicato l'effetto di stato Ferita Aperta per secondValue sec.
L'effetto di stato Ferita Aperta de-amplifica l'effetto di recupero HP e l'effetto di assorbimento dei danni degli scudi lanciati contro il bersaglio del firstValue%.

de.title: Offene Wunde
de.description: Auraklinge hinterlässt eine Wunde, die schwer zu heilen ist.
de.detailDescription:
Wenn der VERT/Ausweich-ignorierende Schlag der Auraklinge das Ziel trifft, wird der Status Effekt Offene Wunde für secondValue Sek. angewendet.
Der Status Effekt Offene Wunde schwächt den HP-Wiederherstellungseffekt und den Schadensabsorptionseffekt von Schilden, die auf das Ziel gewirkt werden, um firstValue%.

th.title: แผลเปิด
th.description: ออราเบลดทำให้เกิดแผลที่รักษาได้ยาก
th.detailDescription:
เมื่อการโจมตีของออราเบลดที่เพิกเฉยต่อ DEF/การหลบหลีก โจมตีโดนเป้าหมาย จะเกิดเอฟเฟกต์สถานะแผลเปิดเป็นเวลา secondValue วิ
เอฟเฟกต์สถานะแผลเปิดนี้จะทำให้เอฟเฟกต์การฟื้น HP และเอฟเฟกต์การดูดซับความเสียหายของโล่ที่อยู่บนเป้าหมายลดฮวบลง firstValue%

vi.title: Vết Thương Hở
vi.description: Blade Aura gây ra những vết thương khó lành.
vi.detailDescription:
Khi đòn tấn công bỏ qua phòng thủ và né tránh của Aura Blade trúng đích, áp dụng debuff Hiệu ứng CC Vết thương hở trong secondValue giây.
Hiệu ứng CC Vết thương hở làm giảm hiệu ứng hồi HP được thi triển lên đối tượng và lượng hấp thụ sát thương của lớp bảo vệ giảm mạnh firstValue%.

id.title: Luka Terbuka
id.description: Pisau Aura meninggalkan luka yang sulit dipulihkan.
id.detailDescription:
Saat serangan Pisau Aura yang mengabaikan hindaran/DEF mengenai target, efek status Luka Terbuka diterapkan selama secondValue detik.
Efek status Luka Terbuka melemahkan efek pemulihan HP dan efek penyerapan kerusakan perisai pada target sebesar firstValue%.

ko.title: 묵직한 회오리
